Guacodile.Name: Guacodile
Guacodile.Description: [aquatic]. When destroyed: Do 4 damage to a Zombie here.
Guacodile.LongDescription: [aquatic] \nWhen destroyed: Do 4 damage to a Zombie here.
Guacodile.FlavorText: Technically I'm a food, not a Plant.

Conga_Zombie.Name: Conga Zombie
Conga_Zombie.FlavorText: Important Note: The fruit on her hat is made of plastic.

Tennis_Champ.Name: Tennis Champ
Tennis_Champ.FlavorText: When it's Plants vs. Zombies, the score is never love-love.

Conehead.Name: Conehead
Conehead.FlavorText: Almost went out with a lampshade on his head. Thought better of it.

All-Star_Zombie.Name: All-Star Zombie
All-Star_Zombie.FlavorText: Gives 110% on the field. Has no idea what a football is.

Smashing_Pumpkin.Name: Smashing Pumpkin
Smashing_Pumpkin.FlavorText: Sure, he and Squash are pals. But there's always an undercurrent of competition between them.

Navy_Bean.Name: Navy Bean
Navy_Bean.FlavorText: Was *this* close to becoming an Army Bean.

Pismashio.Name: Pismashio
Pismashio.FlavorText: I'm a kind of ice cream! Sort of!

Peashooter.Name: Peashooter
Peashooter.FlavorText: Started fighting Zombies in 2009... and never stopped.

Squash.Name: Squash
Squash.FlavorText: Has a bad case of Resting Squash Face.

Bungee_Plumber.Name: Bungee Plumber
Bungee_Plumber.FlavorText: Likes: Plumbing and adventure sports. Dislikes: Belts.

Monster_Mash.Name: Monster Mash
Monster_Mash.FlavorText: Zombies never feel more alive than when they're dancing.

Sour_Grapes.Name: Sour Grapes
Sour_Grapes.FlavorText: Sour. Bitter. Resentful. It's all true. But he's got his reasons.

Grow-Shroom.Name: Grow-Shroom
Grow-Shroom.FlavorText: She's always bringing out the best in others.

Berry_Angry.Name: Berry Angry
Berry_Angry.FlavorText: Now you've done it! That's the last straw! I'm gonna berry you!

Medic.Name: Medic
Medic.FlavorText: It's hard keeping Zombies on their feet. It's harder keeping feet on the Zombies.

Imp.Name: Imp
Imp.FlavorText: He's proficient in Zombie judo and Zombie karate. He also plays the Melodica.

Sea-Shroom.Name: Sea-Shroom
Sea-Shroom.FlavorText: Teaches swimming lessons to disadvantaged Plants in his spare time.

Smoosh-Shroom.Name: Smoosh-Shroom
Smoosh-Shroom.FlavorText: If I had a hammer... Wait a sec... I AM a hammer!

Bonk_Choy.Name: Bonk Choy
Bonk_Choy.FlavorText: Little known fact: He used to have two teeth.

Vanilla.Name: Vanilla
Vanilla.FlavorText: I'm sorry, it's just... I have nothing interesting to say.

Bluesberry.Name: Bluesberry
Bluesberry.FlavorText: Loves to make Zombies sing the blues.

Zapricot.Name: Zapricot
Zapricot.FlavorText: Some say that Zombies aren't easily shocked. I beg to differ.

Fire_Peashooter.Name: Fire Peashooter
Fire_Peashooter.FlavorText: Is it getting hot in here or is it just me?

Fertilize.Name: Fertilize
Fertilize.FlavorText: Stinky, sure, but powerful stuff. Ask any Plant.

Skyshooter.Name: Skyshooter
Skyshooter.FlavorText: The youngest Peashooter ever to earn a pilot's license. Also the only Peashooter ever to earn a pilot's license.

Cattail.Name: Cattail
Cattail.FlavorText: My secret weapon? It's my cute little hat!

2nd-Best_Taco_of_All_Time.Name: 2nd-Best Taco of All Time
2nd-Best_Taco_of_All_Time.FlavorText: Significantly better than the 3rd-Best Taco of All Time.

Cell_Phone_Zombie.Name: Cell Phone Zombie
Cell_Phone_Zombie.FlavorText: Hang on - he's got to take this.

Fun-Dead_Raiser.Name: Fun-Dead Raiser
Fun-Dead_Raiser.FlavorText: Pledge now and get two Zombies plus a free tote bag.

Kite_Flyer.Name: Kite Flyer
Kite_Flyer.Description: [gravestone]. When this does damage, draw a card.
Kite_Flyer.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nWhen this does damage, draw a card.
Kite_Flyer.FlavorText: The naysayers were right. Flying a kite in a lightning storm WAS a real bright idea.

Landscaper.Name: Landscaper
Landscaper.FlavorText: If barren rock and wilted Plants are what you want, he's the landscaper for the job.

Terrify.Name: Terrify
Terrify.Description: Move a Plant. Conjure a Monster.
Terrify.FlavorText: Just a disembodied Zombie head screaming uncontrollably. Nope. Nothing terrifying about that.

Snorkel_Zombie.Name: Snorkel Zombie
Snorkel_Zombie.FlavorText: Breathing out: check. Breathing in? Not so much.

Vitamin_Z.Name: Vitamin Z
Vitamin_Z.FlavorText: Side effects include headaches, blurred vision, and insatiable hunger.

Cat_Lady.Name: Cat Lady
Cat_Lady.Description: Gets [+3a] this turn when you play a Pet.
Cat_Lady.LongDescription: This gets [+3a] this turn when you play a Pet.
Cat_Lady.FlavorText: The cat on the left is a Z-Tube celebrity.

Dolphin_Rider.Name: Dolphin Rider
Dolphin_Rider.FlavorText: The dolphin is also a Zombie.

Nibble.Name: Nibble
Nibble.Description: A Plant gets [-1a]/[-1h]. If this destroys it, [Conjure] a Gourmet card.
Nibble.LongDescription: A Plant gets [-1a]/[-1h].\nIf this destroys that Plant, [Conjure] a Gourmet card.

Deep_Sea_Gargantuar.Name: Deep Sea Gargantuar
Deep_Sea_Gargantuar.Description: [aquatic] [hunt] When a Zombie enters a lane, it gets [+1a]/[+1h].
Deep_Sea_Gargantuar.LongDescription: [aquatic] [hunt] When any Zombie enters any lane, that Zombie gets [+1a]/[+1h].
Deep_Sea_Gargantuar.FlavorText: Has every single issue of Deep Sea Quarterly, but rarely has time to read them.

Zombot_1000.Name: Zombot 1000
Zombot_1000.Description: [Gravestone]. When revealed: Destroy all Plants here and next door.
Zombot_1000.LongDescription: [Gravestone]. When revealed: Destroy all Plants here and next door.
Zombot_1000.FlavorText: The first 999 Zombots are now considered classics.

Cuckoo_Zombie.Name: Cuckoo Zombie
Cuckoo_Zombie.FlavorText: He always knows what time it is. CRAZY TIME!

Walrus_Rider.Name: Walrus Rider
Walrus_Rider.FlavorText: A walrus seemed the obvious choice. After all, horses don't go on land *and* water.

Admiral_Navy_Bean.Name: Admiral Navy Bean
Admiral_Navy_Bean.Description: [aquatic], [teamup]. When you play a Bean, do 2 damage to the Zombie Hero.
Admiral_Navy_Bean.LongDescription: [aquatic], [teamup]\nWhen you play a Bean, do 2 damage to the Zombie Hero.
Admiral_Navy_Bean.FlavorText: Heavy is the weight of command. And my cap. Heavy is the cap.

Wall-Nut.Name: Wall-Nut
Wall-Nut.FlavorText: Works well with others. Says so, right there on his resume.

Cactus.Name: Cactus
Cactus.FlavorText: It's true. I'm prickly on the outside but spongy on the inside.

Steel_Magnolia.Name: Steel Magnolia
Steel_Magnolia.Description: Plants here and next door get [+2h].
Steel_Magnolia.LongDescription: When played: Plants here and next door get [+2h].
Steel_Magnolia.FlavorText: She's got nerves of steel... and everything else of steel!

Jugger-Nut.Name: Jugger-Nut
Jugger-Nut.FlavorText: What's better than a Wall-Nut? A Wall-Nut in a suit of armor, that's what.

Smackadamia.Name: Smackadamia
Smackadamia.FlavorText: Smackadamia wasn't born with smack smarts. He studied hard. He's a smackademic.

Poppin'_Poppies.Name: Poppin' Poppies
Poppin'_Poppies.LongDescription: When played: Make [linklilbuddies] here and next door.

Potato_Mine.Name: Potato Mine
Potato_Mine.Description: [teamup]. When destroyed: Do 2 damage to a Zombie here.
Potato_Mine.LongDescription: [teamup]\nWhen destroyed: Do 2 damage to a Zombie here.

Water_Chestnut.Name: Water Chestnut
Water_Chestnut.FlavorText: 300 laps a day, every day. That's how I do it.

Sting_Bean.Name: Sting Bean
Sting_Bean.FlavorText: I try to warn them, 'This is going to sting.' But the Zombies, they never listen.

Pea-Nut.Name: Pea-Nut
Pea-Nut.FlavorText: Mom was a Peashooter. Dad was a Nut. Everyone said it wouldn't work, but they were wrong.

Prickly_Pear.Name: Prickly Pear
Prickly_Pear.Description: [teamup]. When hurt: Do 2 damage to the Zombie Hero.
Prickly_Pear.LongDescription: [teamup]\nWhen hurt: Do 2 damage to the Zombie Hero.
Prickly_Pear.FlavorText: You hurt me, I hurt you. That's how this works.

Spineapple.Name: Spineapple
Spineapple.Description: When played: Plants with no Strength get [+2a].
Spineapple.LongDescription: When played: Plants with no Strength get [+2a].
Spineapple.FlavorText: Don't let his gruff exterior fool you. He's always looking out for the little guy.

Soul_Patch.Name: Soul Patch
Soul_Patch.Description: [armored=1]. If your Hero would get hurt, this gets hurt instead.
Soul_Patch.LongDescription: [armored=1] \nIf your Hero would get hurt, this gets hurt instead.
Soul_Patch.FlavorText: Has been gently encouraging Cherry Bomb and Sour Grapes to attend his meditation class.

Wall-Nut_Bowling.Name: Wall-Nut Bowling
Wall-Nut_Bowling.Description: Make a [wallnut] in each Ground lane. Attack for 6 damage in those lanes.
Wall-Nut_Bowling.LongDescription: Make a [wallnut] in each Ground lane. Attack for 6 damage in those lanes.

Shroom_for_Two.Name: Shroom for Two
Shroom_for_Two.FlavorText: Shrooms, bless their hearts, always wanting to cuddle up cuddly-like.

Mushroom_Ringleader.Name: Mushroom Ringleader
Mushroom_Ringleader.LongDescription: When played: This gets [+2a] for each other Plant.
Mushroom_Ringleader.FlavorText: Leadership comes with a lot of responsibility, but he knew what he signed up for.

Poison_Ivy.Name: Poison Ivy
Poison_Ivy.FlavorText: Guess who's itching for a fight? This guy right here!

Buff-Shroom.Name: Buff-Shroom
Buff-Shroom.FlavorText: You might know him from his wildly popular series of workout videos called "30 Days to a Buff-Shroom Body.

Petal-Morphosis.Name: Petal-Morphosis
Petal-Morphosis.Description: Transform a Plant into a random Plant. Draw a card.
Petal-Morphosis.LongDescription: Transform a Plant into a random Plant. \nDraw a card.
Petal-Morphosis.FlavorText: For when it's time to turn over a new leaf.

Cherry_Bomb.Name: Cherry Bomb
Cherry_Bomb.Description: Do 4 damage to each Zombie here and next door.
Cherry_Bomb.LongDescription: Do 4 damage to each Zombie here and next door.

Wild_Berry.Name: Wild Berry
Wild_Berry.Description: [ambush=2] When played: Moves to a random lane.
Wild_Berry.LongDescription: [ambush=2] When played:\nThis moves to a random lane.
Wild_Berry.FlavorText: What one word best describes Wild Berry? "Unpredictable.

Pair_of_Pears.Name: Pair of Pears
Pair_of_Pears.Description: Make a [2a]/[2h] Pear Pal with [teamup] here.
Pair_of_Pears.LongDescription: When played:\nMake a [2a]/[2h] Pear Pal with [teamup] here.
Pair_of_Pears.FlavorText: It's cute how they're always completing each other's sentences.

Poison_Mushroom.Name: Poison Mushroom
Poison_Mushroom.FlavorText: Zombie Heroes. Don't like 'em. Not one bit. Don't care who knows it, either.

Sizzle.Name: Sizzle
Sizzle.FlavorText: Incredibly hot and full of electricity. So much ouch.

Seedling.Name: Seedling
Seedling.Description: Start of Turn: This transforms into a random Plant that costs [6s] or less.
Seedling.LongDescription: Start of Turn: This transforms into a random Plant that costs [6s] or less.
Seedling.FlavorText: It's the tiny seed of a... nobody actually knows.

Grapes_of_Wrath.Name: Grapes of Wrath
Grapes_of_Wrath.Description: When destroyed: Do 6 damage to the Zombie Hero.
Grapes_of_Wrath.LongDescription: When destroyed: Do 6 damage to the Zombie Hero.
Grapes_of_Wrath.FlavorText: Everyone's always asking, Why so angry? Because ZOMBIES! Sheesh. Obviously.

Sergeant_Strongberry.Name: Sergeant Strongberry
Sergeant_Strongberry.Description: When another Berry hurts a Zombie or Zombie Hero, Sergeant Strongberry does 2 more damage to that enemy.
Sergeant_Strongberry.LongDescription: When another Berry hurts a Zombie or Zombie Hero, Sergeant Strongberry does 2 more damage to that enemy.
Sergeant_Strongberry.FlavorText: He's intense, sure. But he just wants the berries to be all they can be.

Pineclone.Name: Pineclone
Pineclone.LongDescription: When played: Transform all Plants into [3a]/[3h] Pineclones.
Pineclone.FlavorText: It's nothing personal. She just prefers the company of other Pineclones.

Cornucopia.Name: Cornucopia
Cornucopia.Description: Make a random Plant in each other lane.
Cornucopia.LongDescription: When played: Make a random Plant in each other lane.

Repeater.Name: Repeater
Repeater.FlavorText: Yes! Yes! Let's do this! Let's do this!

Torchwood.Name: Torchwood
Torchwood.FlavorText: Feel the burn, I COMMAND YOU!

Super-Phat_Beets.Name: Super-Phat Beets
Super-Phat_Beets.Description: Gets [+1a]/[+1h] for each other Plant and Zombie.
Super-Phat_Beets.LongDescription: When played: This gets [+1a]/[+1h] for each other Plant and Zombie.
Super-Phat_Beets.FlavorText: When he drops the beet, everyone feels it. Especially the Zombies.

Pea_Pod.Name: Pea Pod
Pea_Pod.FlavorText: Sometimes they squabble, but they usually get along like five peas in a pod.

Party_Thyme.Name: Party Thyme
Party_Thyme.Description: When a Plant does a Bonus Attack, draw a card.
Party_Thyme.LongDescription: When a Plant does a Bonus Attack, draw a card.

Plant_Food.Name: Plant Food
Plant_Food.Description: A Plant gets [+1a]/[+1h] then does a Bonus Attack.
Plant_Food.LongDescription: A Plant gets [+1a]/[+1h] then does a Bonus Attack.
Plant_Food.FlavorText: The most important meal of the day.

Sweet_Potato.Name: Sweet Potato
Sweet_Potato.Description: [teamup]. Move a Zombie to this lane.
Sweet_Potato.LongDescription: [teamup]\nWhen played: Move a Zombie to this lane.
Sweet_Potato.FlavorText: Loves unicorns and rainbows... and watching cats on the Internet.

Re-Peat_Moss.Name: Re-Peat Moss
Re-Peat_Moss.Description: When you play a Trick, this does a Bonus Attack.
Re-Peat_Moss.LongDescription: When you play a Trick, this does a Bonus Attack.
Re-Peat_Moss.FlavorText: To do what I do... it's TRICKY. I'll leave it at that.

Black-Eyed_Pea.Name: Black-Eyed Pea
Black-Eyed_Pea.Description: Gets [+1a]/[+1h] when a Zombie Trick is played.
Black-Eyed_Pea.LongDescription: This gets [+1a]/[+1h] when a Zombie Trick is played.
Black-Eyed_Pea.FlavorText: You shoulda seen the other guy!

Potted_Powerhouse.Name: Potted Powerhouse
Potted_Powerhouse.Description: While in your hand: This gets [+1a]/[+1h] when a Plant gains Strength or Health.
Potted_Powerhouse.LongDescription: While in your hand: This gets [+1a]/[+1h] when a Plant gains Strength or Health.
Potted_Powerhouse.FlavorText: She loves living out of a pot. It's not for every Plant. But to her, it's home.

Morning_Glory.Name: Morning Glory
Morning_Glory.Description: When played: Gets [+1a]/[+1h] if you made at least [6s] this turn.
Morning_Glory.LongDescription: When played: This gets [+1a]/[+1h] if you made at least [6s] this turn.
Morning_Glory.FlavorText: Just don't talk to her before she's had her Coffee Bean.

Doubled_Mint.Name: Doubled Mint
Doubled_Mint.Description: Start of turn: Double this Plant's Strength and Health.
Doubled_Mint.LongDescription: Start of Turn: Double this Plant's Strength and Health.
Doubled_Mint.FlavorText: He'll grow on you. Just give him time.

Bananasaurus_Rex.Name: Bananasaurus Rex
Bananasaurus_Rex.FlavorText: She's a banana first and a dinosaur second. But it's a close second.

Jumping_Bean.Name: Jumping Bean
Jumping_Bean.FlavorText: I'm more than just a jumper... I can also leap and vault!

Chilly_Pepper.Name: Chilly Pepper
Chilly_Pepper.FlavorText: It's not easy being both hot *and* cold. A comfortable lukewarm might be nice for a change.

Rescue_Radish.Name: Rescue Radish
Rescue_Radish.FlavorText: He puts the rad in radish.

Snowdrop.Name: Snowdrop
Snowdrop.Description: Gets [+2a]/[+2h] when a Zombie is frozen.
Snowdrop.LongDescription: This gets [+2a]/[+2h] when a Zombie is frozen.
Snowdrop.FlavorText: Zombies are always looking at her with a frozen expression.

Carrotillery.Name: Carrotillery
Carrotillery.FlavorText: His artillery is a rich source of vitamin A and beta-carotene - a fact the Zombies do not seem to appreciate.

Threepeater.Name: Threepeater
Threepeater.LongDescription: This attacks here and next door.

Winter_Squash.Name: Winter Squash
Winter_Squash.Description: When a Zombie or Gravestone is frozen, destroy it.
Winter_Squash.LongDescription: When a Zombie or Gravestone is frozen, destroy it.
Winter_Squash.FlavorText: My complexion is more of a summer.

Snow_Pea.Name: Snow Pea
Snow_Pea.Description: When this hurts a Zombie, [freeze] that Zombie.
Snow_Pea.LongDescription: When this hurts a Zombie, [freeze] that Zombie.
Snow_Pea.FlavorText: Learned everything he knows during the Great Freeze Tag Wars of '08.

Shellery.Name: Shellery
Shellery.FlavorText: Ordinance is most effective with peanut butter and raisins.

Fume-Shroom.Name: Fume-Shroom
Fume-Shroom.FlavorText: I'm like the wind. Near a hog farm.

Iceberg_Lettuce.Name: Iceberg Lettuce
Iceberg_Lettuce.FlavorText: FREEZE! Ha, just kidding. Little Iceberg humor there.

Bean_Counter.Name: Bean Counter
Bean_Counter.Description: [teamup] Gets [+1a]/[+1h] when you play a Bean. When played: Gain two Weenie Beanies.
Bean_Counter.LongDescription: [teamup]\nThis gets [+1a]/[+1h] when you play a Bean.\nWhen played: Gain two [1a]/[1h] Weenie Beanies.
Bean_Counter.FlavorText: Every bean is accounted for. I assure you, they all add up.

Brainana.Name: Brainana
Brainana.Description: [aquatic]. The Zombie Hero loses their Brains.
Brainana.LongDescription: [aquatic]\nWhen played: The Zombie Hero loses their Brains.
Brainana.FlavorText: In this case, "brain drain" is a good thing.

Winter_Melon.Name: Winter Melon
Winter_Melon.Description: [splashdamage=4] When played: Freeze a Zombie. When this hurts a Zombie, [freeze] that Zombie.
Winter_Melon.LongDescription: [splashdamage=4]\nWhen played: Freeze a Zombie. When this hurts a Zombie, [freeze] that Zombie.

Snapdragon.Name: Snapdragon
Snapdragon.FlavorText: I'm a dragon; I'm a Plant... I'm a mystery!

Sunflower.Name: Sunflower
Sunflower.Description: [teamup]. Start of Turn: You get [+1s] this turn.
Sunflower.LongDescription: [teamup]\nStart of Turn: You get [+1s] this turn.
Sunflower.FlavorText: Not to brag, but I'm pretty much your basic franchise-founding superstar.

Sage_Sage.Name: Sage Sage
Sage_Sage.Description: If you made at least [6s] this turn, draw a card.
Sage_Sage.LongDescription: When played: If you made at least [6s] this turn, draw a card.
Sage_Sage.FlavorText: Got his start writing messages for fortune cookies.

Mixed_Nuts.Name: Mixed Nuts
Mixed_Nuts.Description: Gets [+2a]/[+2h] if there's a Plant with [teamup] here.
Mixed_Nuts.LongDescription: When played: This gets [+2a]/[+2h] if there's a Plant with [teamup] here.
Mixed_Nuts.FlavorText: They work hard but they also like to party. That's them in a nutshell.

Bloomerang.Name: Bloomerang
Bloomerang.FlavorText: Magnets? Gravity? Crikey, I don't have a clue why they come back.

Power_Flower.Name: Power Flower
Power_Flower.Description: [strikethrough]. Start of turn: Heal your Hero for 1 for each Flower.
Power_Flower.LongDescription: [strikethrough]\nStart of turn: Heal your Hero for 1 for each Flower.
Power_Flower.FlavorText: Dropped out of Kale University to practice natural medicine.

Venus_Flytrap.Name: Venus Flytrap
Venus_Flytrap.Description: When this does damage, heal your Hero that much.
Venus_Flytrap.LongDescription: When this does damage, heal your Hero that much.
Venus_Flytrap.FlavorText: Mom always said, 'If you leave your trap open like that, you'll catch Zombies.' So I did.

Pepper_M.D..Name: Pepper M.D.
Pepper_M.D..Description: Gets [+2a]/[+2h] when a Plant or your Hero is healed.
Pepper_M.D..LongDescription: This gets [+2a]/[+2h] when a Plant or your Hero is healed.
Pepper_M.D..FlavorText: A toast to your health... and mine!

Metal_Petal_Sunflower.Name: Metal Petal Sunflower
Metal_Petal_Sunflower.Description: Start of Turn: You get [+1s] this turn.
Metal_Petal_Sunflower.LongDescription: Start of Turn: You get [+1s] this turn.
Metal_Petal_Sunflower.FlavorText: Time to put the metal to the petal, baby!

Muscle_Sprout.Name: Muscle Sprout
Muscle_Sprout.Description: Gets [+1a]/[+1h] when you play a Plant.
Muscle_Sprout.LongDescription: This gets [+1a]/[+1h] when you play a Plant.

Twin_Sunflower.Name: Twin Sunflower
Twin_Sunflower.Description: [teamup]. Start of Turn: You get [+2s] this turn.

Laser_Bean.Name: Laser Bean
Laser_Bean.Description: [strikethrough]. When played: This gets [+1a] for each Sun you made this turn.
Laser_Bean.LongDescription: [strikethrough]. \nWhen played: This gets [+1a] for each Sun you made this turn.
Laser_Bean.FlavorText: Physics, baby! I'm emittin' all KINDS of coherent radiation!

Lawnmower.Name: Lawnmower
Lawnmower.Description: Destroy a Zombie on the Ground.
Lawnmower.LongDescription: Destroy a Zombie on the Ground.

Chomper.Name: Chomper
Chomper.Description: Destroy a Zombie here with [3a] or less.
Chomper.LongDescription: When played: Destroy a Zombie here with [3a] or less.
Chomper.FlavorText: A free buffet? How kind! Don't mind if I do!

Magnifying_Grass.Name: Magnifying Grass
Magnifying_Grass.Description: When played: This gets [+1a] for each Sun you made this turn.
Magnifying_Grass.LongDescription: When played: This gets [+1a] for each Sun you made this turn.
Magnifying_Grass.FlavorText: Zombies may appear closer than they are.

Briar_Rose.Name: Briar Rose
Briar_Rose.Description: When a Zombie hurts a Flower, destroy that Zombie.
Briar_Rose.LongDescription: When a Zombie hurts a Flower, destroy that Zombie.
Briar_Rose.FlavorText: You mess with the rose, you get the thorns!

Dandy_Lion_King.Name: Dandy Lion King
Dandy_Lion_King.Description: Damage the Zombie Hero for [halfrounddown] their Health.
Dandy_Lion_King.LongDescription: When played: Damage the Zombie Hero for [halfrounddown] their Health.
Dandy_Lion_King.FlavorText: He's developed a taste for Zombie Heroes.

Three-Headed_Chomper.Name: Three-Headed Chomper
Three-Headed_Chomper.Description: End of Turn: Destroy all Zombies here and next door.
Three-Headed_Chomper.LongDescription: End of Turn: Destroy all Zombies here and next door.
Three-Headed_Chomper.FlavorText: You know that old saying, 'Three heads are better than one'? Totally true.

Electrician.Name: Electrician
Electrician.Description: [gravestone]. When revealed: A Zombie does a Bonus Attack.
Electrician.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nWhen revealed: A Zombie does a Bonus Attack.
Electrician.FlavorText: He charges for the full hour.

Paparazzi_Zombie.Name: Paparazzi Zombie
Paparazzi_Zombie.Description: Gets [+1a]/[+1h] when you play a Trick.
Paparazzi_Zombie.LongDescription: This gets [+1a]/[+1h] when you play a Trick.
Paparazzi_Zombie.FlavorText: Why is everyone always screaming and running away in his photos?

Gadget_Scientist.Name: Gadget Scientist
Gadget_Scientist.Description: Each Science Zombie does a Bonus Attack.
Gadget_Scientist.LongDescription: When played: Each Science Zombie does a Bonus Attack.
Gadget_Scientist.FlavorText: Wishes the Mad Chemist would stop copying his hair style.

Rocket_Science.Name: Rocket Science
Rocket_Science.Description: Destroy a Plant that has [4a] or more.
Rocket_Science.LongDescription: Destroy a Plant that has [4a] or more.
Rocket_Science.FlavorText: Turns out, it IS rocket science.

Zombot_Drone_Engineer.Name: Zombot Drone Engineer
Zombot_Drone_Engineer.Description: [gravestone] When a Science Zombie does damage, that Zombie gets [+1a].
Zombot_Drone_Engineer.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nWhen a Science Zombie does damage, that Zombie gets [+1a].
Zombot_Drone_Engineer.FlavorText: He's not entirely sure how to fly this thing.

Copter_Commando.Name: Copter Commando
Copter_Commando.FlavorText: Refuses to fly over water due to a severe case of aquaphobia.

Lurch_for_Lunch.Name: Lurch for Lunch
Lurch_for_Lunch.Description: A Zombie does a Bonus Attack.
Lurch_for_Lunch.LongDescription: A Zombie does a Bonus Attack.

Wizard_Gargantuar.Name: Wizard Gargantuar
Wizard_Gargantuar.Description: All Gargantuars have [truestrike]. Transform another Zombie into a random Zombie that costs 1 more.
Wizard_Gargantuar.LongDescription: All Gargantuars have [truestrike]. \nWhen played: Transform another Zombie into a random Zombie that costs 1 more.
Wizard_Gargantuar.FlavorText: A wizard did it. An enormous, green, Zombie wizard.

Mad_Chemist.Name: Mad Chemist
Mad_Chemist.Description: [gravestone]. When you play your first Trick each turn, [conjure] a Trick, and it costs 1 less.
Mad_Chemist.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nWhen you play your first Trick each turn, [conjure] a Trick, and it costs 1 less.
Mad_Chemist.FlavorText: He's not so much "mad" as he is "mildly annoyed.

Trickster.Name: Trickster
Trickster.Description: While in your hand: This costs [1b] less when you play a Trick. When played: This does a Bonus Attack.
Trickster.LongDescription: While in your hand: This costs [1b] less when you play a Trick.\nWhen played: This does a Bonus Attack.
Trickster.FlavorText: Never gets tired of the rubber chicken gag.

Shieldcrusher_Viking.Name: Shieldcrusher Viking
Shieldcrusher_Viking.Description: [truestrike]. When played and When this hurts the Plant Hero, empty their Block Meter.
Shieldcrusher_Viking.LongDescription: [truestrike]\nWhen played and When this hurts the Plant Hero, empty their Block Meter.
Shieldcrusher_Viking.FlavorText: Been crushing shields since the 9th Century. Has gotten pretty darn good at it.

Arm_Wrestler.Name: Arm Wrestler
Arm_Wrestler.Description: Gets [+1a]/[+1h] when a Plant enters this lane.
Arm_Wrestler.LongDescription: This gets [+1a]/[+1h] when a Plant enters this lane.
Arm_Wrestler.FlavorText: Lots of carbs, lots of protein, and five brain shakes a day.

Sumo_Wrestler.Name: Sumo Wrestler
Sumo_Wrestler.FlavorText: Hey, he's in shape. Round is a shape.

Rolling_Stone.Name: Rolling Stone
Rolling_Stone.Description: Destroy a Plant with [2a] or less.
Rolling_Stone.LongDescription: Destroy a Plant with [2a] or less.
Rolling_Stone.FlavorText: Gives new meaning to the phrase "rock n' roll".

Zombie_Coach.Name: Zombie Coach
Zombie_Coach.Description: All Sports Zombies can't be hurt this turn.
Zombie_Coach.LongDescription: When played: All Sports Zombies can't be hurt this turn.

Flag_Zombie.Name: Flag Zombie
Flag_Zombie.FlavorText: He's not patriotic; he just likes fabric suspended from sticks.

Buckethead.Name: Buckethead
Buckethead.FlavorText: Why a bucket? Well, gosh, in this economy, why NOT?

Trash_Can_Zombie.Name: Trash Can Zombie
Trash_Can_Zombie.Description: [gravestone]. When revealed: This can't be hurt this turn.
Trash_Can_Zombie.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nWhen revealed: This can't be hurt this turn.
Trash_Can_Zombie.FlavorText: It's dark and quiet in there. He finds it soothing. That's what no one gets.

Knight_of_the_Living_Dead.Name: Knight of the Living Dead
Knight_of_the_Living_Dead.FlavorText: He's both secretary and treasurer for the Knights of the Square Table.

Ra_Zombie.Name: Ra Zombie
Ra_Zombie.Description: The Plant Hero loses [2s] this turn.
Ra_Zombie.LongDescription: When played: The Plant Hero loses [2s] this turn.

Weed_Spray.Name: Weed Spray
Weed_Spray.Description: Destroy each Plant with [2a] or less.
Weed_Spray.LongDescription: Destroy each Plant with [2a] or less.
Weed_Spray.FlavorText: Act now! Rids your lawn of pesky weeds... and Peashooters and Sunflowers. Also Wall-Nuts.

Rodeo_Gargantuar.Name: Rodeo Gargantuar
Rodeo_Gargantuar.FlavorText: Why yes, this IS his first rodeo.

Zombie_King.Name: Zombie King
Zombie_King.Description: End of Turn: Transform another Zombie into a [5a]/[5h] Knight with [armored=2].
Zombie_King.LongDescription: End of Turn: Transform another random Zombie into a [5a]/[5h] Knight of the Living Dead with [armored=2].
Zombie_King.FlavorText: Contrary to popular opinion, it's just OK to be king.

Team_Mascot.Name: Team Mascot
Team_Mascot.Description: Start of turn: All Sports Zombies get [+1a]/[+1h].
Team_Mascot.LongDescription: Start of turn: All Sports Zombies get [+1a]/[+1h].
Team_Mascot.FlavorText: Say what you will about the costume - Zombie morale has never been better.

Undying_Pharaoh.Name: Undying Pharaoh
Undying_Pharaoh.Description: [armored=1] Your Hero's Health can't go below 1.
Undying_Pharaoh.FlavorText: If the Plants think they're going to beat the Undying Pharaoh, they're in de-Nile.

Wannabe_Hero.Name: Wannabe Hero
Wannabe_Hero.Description: [frenzy]. Heal 3. Gets [+1h] for each Health your Hero has.
Wannabe_Hero.LongDescription: [frenzy]\nWhen played: Heal 3 Then this gets [+1h] for each Health your Hero has.
Wannabe_Hero.FlavorText: He has Super Brainz stickers all over his binder.

Zombot's_Wrath.Name: Zombot's Wrath
Zombot's_Wrath.Description: Do damage equal to the number of Zombies.
Zombot's_Wrath.LongDescription: Do damage equal to the number of Zombies.
Zombot's_Wrath.FlavorText: Dr. Zomboss believes there's no problem that can't be solved by a giant robot.

Dog_Walker.Name: Dog Walker
Dog_Walker.FlavorText: Is the Zombie walking the dog, or is the dog walking the Zombie? Hard to say.

Pied_Piper.Name: Pied Piper
Pied_Piper.FlavorText: He was told that playing the pipe would summon raccoons. But whatevs.

Haunting_Zombie.Name: Haunting Zombie
Haunting_Zombie.FlavorText: He doesn't realize he would look even scarier without the spooky ghost costume...

Smashing_Gargantuar.Name: Smashing Gargantuar
Smashing_Gargantuar.FlavorText: When he phones home, it means something completely different.

Zookeeper.Name: Zookeeper
Zookeeper.Description: When you play a Pet, all Pets get [+1a].
Zookeeper.LongDescription: When you play a Pet, all Pets get [+1a].

Coffee_Zombie.Name: Coffee Zombie
Coffee_Zombie.FlavorText: He's been trying to cut back.

Zombie_Yeti.Name: Zombie Yeti
Zombie_Yeti.Description: Gain a Yeti Lunchbox. End of turn: [bounce] this Yeti.
Zombie_Yeti.LongDescription: When played: Gain a Yeti Lunchbox.\nEnd of turn: [bounce] this Yeti.

Kangaroo_Rider.Name: Kangaroo Rider
Kangaroo_Rider.FlavorText: Sure, it's a bumpy ride, but it beats walking. Have you seen an Imp's legs?

Nurse_Gargantuar.Name: Nurse Gargantuar
Nurse_Gargantuar.Description: When a Gargantuar does damage, heal your Hero that much.
Nurse_Gargantuar.LongDescription: When a Gargantuar does damage, heal your Hero that much.
Nurse_Gargantuar.FlavorText: Their bedside manner could use some work.

Maniacal_Laugh.Name: Maniacal Laugh
Maniacal_Laugh.FlavorText: It's not so much "hahaha" as it is "mwahahaha.

Octo_Zombie.Name: Octo Zombie
Octo_Zombie.Description: [aquatic], [frenzy]. Make a [+3a]/[+2h] Octo-Pet. When destroyed: Gain an Octo Zombie.
Octo_Zombie.LongDescription: [aquatic], [frenzy]. When played: Make a [+3a]/[+2h] Octo-Pet with Amphibious and Frenzy. \nWhen destroyed: Gain an Octo Zombie..
Octo_Zombie.FlavorText: Is the correct term 'octopuses' or 'octopi'? You'd think he'd have an opinion, but he doesn't.

Exploding_Imp.Name: Exploding Imp
Exploding_Imp.Description: [gravestone]. End of Turn: This does 1 damage to itself.
Exploding_Imp.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nEnd of Turn: This does 1 damage to itself.
Exploding_Imp.FlavorText: You could say he's an IMPlosives expert.

Orchestra_Conductor.Name: Orchestra Conductor
Orchestra_Conductor.FlavorText: He isn't in it for the music. He just likes waving sticks.

Flamenco_Zombie.Name: Flamenco Zombie
Flamenco_Zombie.Description: Do 2 damage to the Plant Hero for each Dancing Zombie.
Flamenco_Zombie.LongDescription: When played: Do 2 damage to the Plant Hero for each Dancing Zombie.
Flamenco_Zombie.FlavorText: Also enjoys dancing the rumba, tango, and the Hokey Pokey.

Imp-Throwing_Gargantuar.Name: Imp-Throwing Gargantuar
Imp-Throwing_Gargantuar.Description: When hurt: Make a [1a]/[1h] Swabbie with [aquatic] in a random lane.
Imp-Throwing_Gargantuar.LongDescription: When hurt: Make a [1a]/[1h] Swabbie with [aquatic] in a random lane.
Imp-Throwing_Gargantuar.FlavorText: Seems like a better idea than a Gargantuar-Throwing Imp.

Unlife_of_the_Party.Name: Unlife of the Party
Unlife_of_the_Party.Description: Gets [+1a]/[+1h] when you play a Zombie.
Unlife_of_the_Party.LongDescription: This gets [+1a]/[+1h] when you play a Zombie.

Jester.Name: Jester
Jester.Description: [gravestone]. When hurt: Do 2 damage to the Plant Hero.
Jester.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nWhen hurt: Do 2 damage to the Plant Hero.

Foot_Soldier_Zombie.Name: Foot Soldier Zombie
Foot_Soldier_Zombie.Description: When played on Heights: Do 3 damage.
Foot_Soldier_Zombie.FlavorText: Each Foot Soldier Zombie shall be issued one (1) combat foot.

Fireworks_Zombie.Name: Fireworks Zombie
Fireworks_Zombie.Description: Do 1 damage to all Plants and Zombies.
Fireworks_Zombie.LongDescription: When played: Do 1 damage to all Plants and Zombies.
Fireworks_Zombie.FlavorText: Want to clear some mushrooms? Fire works.

Valkyrie.Name: Valkyrie
Valkyrie.Description: While in your hand: This gets [+2a] when a Zombie is destroyed.
Valkyrie.LongDescription: While in your hand: This gets [+2a] when a Zombie is destroyed.
Valkyrie.FlavorText: It's not easy hitting those high notes when all you can sing is, "Braaaaains.

Disco-Tron_3000.Name: Disco-Tron 3000
Disco-Tron_3000.Description: [gravestone]. When revealed: make a [3a]/[1h] Disco Zombie that makes a [1a]/[1h] Backup Dancer.
Disco-Tron_3000.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nWhen revealed: Make a [3a]/[1h] Disco Zombie that makes a [1a]/[1h] Backup Dancer.

Gargantuars'_Feast.Name: Gargantuars' Feast
Gargantuars'_Feast.Description: Make 3 random Gargantuars in random Lanes.
Gargantuars'_Feast.LongDescription: Make 3 random Gargantuars in random Lanes.

Zombie_Chicken.Name: Zombie Chicken
Zombie_Chicken.Description: This moves to a random lane when a Plant is played here.
Zombie_Chicken.LongDescription: This moves to a random lane when a Plant is played here.
Zombie_Chicken.FlavorText: Question: Which came first, the Chicken or the egg? Answer: The Zombie!

Stealthy_Imp.Name: Stealthy Imp
Stealthy_Imp.FlavorText: Don't look, but there's one behind you right now!

Smelly_Zombie.Name: Smelly Zombie
Smelly_Zombie.FlavorText: Casual acquaintances don't understand where his pets are. They don't realize that stinkflies can be such tender little friends.

Backyard_Bounce.Name: Backyard Bounce
Backyard_Bounce.FlavorText: Zombies love trampolines. Not everyone knows that.

Imp_Commander.Name: Imp Commander
Imp_Commander.Description: [gravestone]. When an Imp hurts the Plant Hero, draw a card.
Imp_Commander.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nWhen an Imp hurts the Plant Hero, draw a card.
Imp_Commander.FlavorText: He's got a bit of a Napoleon Complex. Obviously.

Swashbuckler_Zombie.Name: Swashbuckler Zombie
Swashbuckler_Zombie.Description: [gravestone]. When a Pirate hurts the Plant Hero, that Pirate gets [+1a]/[+1h].
Swashbuckler_Zombie.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nWhen a Pirate hurts the Plant Hero, that Pirate gets [+1a]/[+1h].
Swashbuckler_Zombie.FlavorText: Buckles his swash like no other.

Surprise_Gargantuar.Name: Surprise Gargantuar
Surprise_Gargantuar.FlavorText: Surprise! It's a brains-eating monster at your party!

Toxic_Waste_Imp.Name: Toxic Waste Imp
Toxic_Waste_Imp.FlavorText: All the radioactive glow... none of the superpowers.

Pogo_Bouncer.Name: Pogo Bouncer
Pogo_Bouncer.FlavorText: Not the most efficient mode of transportation, but definitely the most fun.

Line_Dancing_Zombie.Name: Line Dancing Zombie
Line_Dancing_Zombie.FlavorText: In her opinion, there's no better song to line dance to than the "Zombie Shuffle."

Mini-Ninja.Name: Mini-Ninja
Mini-Ninja.FlavorText: His motto: Walk softly and carry a big nunchuck.

Barrel_Roller_Zombie.Name: Barrel Roller Zombie
Barrel_Roller_Zombie.Description: [deadly]. When destroyed: Make [1a]/[1h] Swabbies with [aquatic] next door.
Barrel_Roller_Zombie.LongDescription: [deadly]\nWhen destroyed: Make [1a]/[1h] Swabbie Imps with [aquatic] next door.
Barrel_Roller_Zombie.FlavorText: The second-most affordable way to transport Imps.

Mixed-Up_Gravedigger.Name: Mixed-Up Gravedigger
Mixed-Up_Gravedigger.Description: Each Zombie hides in a [gravestone]. Mix them up randomly.
Mixed-Up_Gravedigger.LongDescription: When played: Each Zombie hides in a [Gravestone]. Mix them up randomly.
Mixed-Up_Gravedigger.FlavorText: Digging graves is hard work, but seeing customers rise out of them makes it all worth it.

Tomb_Raiser_Zombie.Name: Tomb Raiser Zombie
Tomb_Raiser_Zombie.Description: [gravestone]. When this hurts the Plant Hero, make a random [gravestone] in a random lane.
Tomb_Raiser_Zombie.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nWhen this hurts the Plant Hero, make a random [gravestone] in a random lane.

Vimpire.Name: Vimpire
Vimpire.Description: [frenzy]. Gets [+2a]/[+2h] when it destroys a Plant.
Vimpire.LongDescription: [frenzy]\nThis gets [+2a]/[+2h] when it destroys a Plant.
Vimpire.FlavorText: He vants to suck your chlorophyll.

Zombot_Sharktronic_Sub.Name: Zombot Sharktronic Sub
Zombot_Sharktronic_Sub.Description: [aquatic]. When a Plant gets hurt, destroy it. When a Plant is destroyed, this gets[+1a].
Zombot_Sharktronic_Sub.LongDescription: [aquatic]\nWhen a Plant gets hurt, destroy it.\nWhen any Plant is destroyed, this gets [+1a].
Zombot_Sharktronic_Sub.FlavorText: Ever dream of piloting a giant shark robot? Join Dr. Zomboss now!

Zombot_Plank_Walker.Name: Zombot Plank Walker
Zombot_Plank_Walker.Description: [aquatic], [strikethrough]. Make two other random Pirates in random lanes.
Zombot_Plank_Walker.LongDescription: [aquatic], [strikethrough]\nWhen played: Make two other random Pirates in random lanes.
Zombot_Plank_Walker.FlavorText: Deploying Pirates here, there and everywhere.

Lil'_Buddy.Name: Lil' Buddy
Lil'_Buddy.FlavorText: Wait, you want me to go in *front*?!?

Pear_Pal.Name: Pear Pal
Pear_Pal.FlavorText: Has codependency issues, but he's working on it.

Espresso_Fiesta.Name: Espresso Fiesta
Espresso_Fiesta.Description: A Plant does three Bonus Attacks.
Espresso_Fiesta.LongDescription: A Plant does three Bonus Attacks.
Espresso_Fiesta.FlavorText: Don't consume after 5 p.m. You'll be up all night.

Beam_Me_Up.Name: Beam Me Up
Beam_Me_Up.FlavorText: A sure way to get Space Cadet's attention.

Hail-a-Copter.Name: Hail-a-Copter
Hail-a-Copter.FlavorText: Refuses to fly over water due to a severe case of aquaphobia.

Backup_Dancer.Name: Backup Dancer
Backup_Dancer.FlavorText: Spent six years perfecting his art at the Chewliard School for the Performing Arts.

Poison_Oak.Name: Poison Oak
Poison_Oak.FlavorText: Gets lunch with Poison Ivy and Poison Mushroom every week. They have a lot to talk about.

Kernel_Corn.Name: Kernel Corn
Kernel_Corn.LongDescription: When played: Do 4 damage to each Zombie.
Kernel_Corn.FlavorText: What he lacks in a sense of humor, he makes up for with attitude... and dual Cob Busters.

The_Podfather.Name: The Podfather
The_Podfather.Description: When you play a Pea, that Pea gets [+2a]/[+2h].
The_Podfather.LongDescription: When you play a Pea, that Pea gets [+2a]/[+2h].
The_Podfather.FlavorText: It ain't easy keeping the peas in this family.

Gardening_Gloves.Name: Gardening Gloves
Gardening_Gloves.FlavorText: Made of the softest fabric for that gentle Plant touch.

Lightning_Reed.Name: Lightning Reed
Lightning_Reed.FlavorText: I do it for the shock value.

Water_Balloons.Name: Water Balloons
Water_Balloons.Description: A non-Amphibious Zombie gets [-2a]/[-2h]. If you made at least [6s] this turn, it gets [-3a]/[-3h] instead.
Water_Balloons.LongDescription: A non-Amphibious Zombie gets [-2a]/[-2h].\nIf you made at least [6s] this turn, it gets [-3a]/[-3h] instead.
Water_Balloons.FlavorText: You're gonna need a towel for this one.

Portal_Technician.Name: Portal Technician
Portal_Technician.Description: When destroyed: Make a random Zombie here.
Portal_Technician.LongDescription: When destroyed: Make a random Zombie here.
Portal_Technician.FlavorText: Soon everyone will own their own portal. But for now, he enjoys being an early adopter.

Loudmouth.Name: Loudmouth
Loudmouth.FlavorText: What he lacks in size, he makes up for in volume.

Squirrel_Herder.Name: Squirrel Herder
Squirrel_Herder.Description: [gravestone]. When revealed: Destroy one of their Nuts or Berries.
Squirrel_Herder.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nWhen revealed: Destroy one of their Nuts or Berries.
Squirrel_Herder.FlavorText: The only thing more difficult than herding cats.

Aerobics_Instructor.Name: Aerobics Instructor
Aerobics_Instructor.Description: Start of turn: All Dancing Zombies get [+2a].
Aerobics_Instructor.LongDescription: Start of Turn: All Dancing Zombies get [+2a].
Aerobics_Instructor.FlavorText: Aerobics really bring the dead to life.

Abracadaver.Name: Abracadaver
Abracadaver.Description: [gravestone]. When this hurts the Plant Hero, do 3 damage to a random Plant.
Abracadaver.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nWhen this hurts the Plant Hero, do 3 damage to a random Plant.
Abracadaver.FlavorText: Keeps forgetting that the magic word is "Please.

Firefighter.Name: Firefighter
Firefighter.FlavorText: He's a little too eager to rescue kittens from trees.

Puff-Shroom.Name: Puff-Shroom
Puff-Shroom.FlavorText: He huffs and puffs and, occasionally, blows a Zombie down.

Mountain_Climber.Name: Mountain Climber
Mountain_Climber.FlavorText: She's climbed 'em all: Everest. K2. Your house.

The_Great_Zucchini.Name: The Great Zucchini
The_Great_Zucchini.LongDescription: [aquatic]\nWhen played: Transform all Zombies into [1a]/[1h] Zombies with no abilities.
The_Great_Zucchini.FlavorText: Presto change-o! Now you see a powerful Zombie. Now you don't!

Doom-Shroom.Name: Doom-Shroom
Doom-Shroom.Description: Destroy all Plants and Zombies with [4a] or more. Draw a Mushroom card.
Doom-Shroom.LongDescription: Destroy all Plants and Zombies with [4a] or more.\n Draw a Mushroom card.
Doom-Shroom.FlavorText: I could destroy everything you hold dear. It wouldn't be hard.

Mirror-Nut.Name: Mirror-Nut
Mirror-Nut.Description: [teamup]. [truestrike]. When your Nuts get hurt, do 1 damage to the Zombie Hero.
Mirror-Nut.LongDescription: [teamup] [truestrike]\nWhen your Nuts get hurt, do 1 damage to the Zombie Hero.
Mirror-Nut.FlavorText: Dressed up as a mirrorball for a disco-themed party. Never looked back.

Gentleman_Zombie.Name: Gentleman Zombie
Gentleman_Zombie.Description: [gravestone]. Start of Tricks: You get [+2b] this turn.
Gentleman_Zombie.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nStart of Tricks: You get [+2b] this turn.
Gentleman_Zombie.FlavorText: Life comes and goes, but proper manners are forever.

Smoke_Bomb.Name: Smoke Bomb
Smoke_Bomb.FlavorText: Good for eluding the enemy. Bad for the lungs.

Camel_Crossing.Name: Camel Crossing
Camel_Crossing.FlavorText: Camels - they're filthy, ill-tempered animals that'll spit on you just for fun. But Zombies love 'em all the same.

Headstone_Carver.Name: Headstone Carver
Headstone_Carver.Description: When a Zombie is revealed from a Gravestone, that Zombie gets [+1a]/[+1h].
Headstone_Carver.LongDescription: When a Zombie is revealed from a Gravestone, that Zombie gets [+1a]/[+1h].
Headstone_Carver.FlavorText: His epitaphs have been published on headstones around the world.

Tough_Beets.Name: Tough Beets
Tough_Beets.Description: [armored=1]. Gets [+1a]/[+1h] for each other Plant and Zombie.
Tough_Beets.LongDescription: [armored=1]\nWhen played: This gets [+1a]/[+1h] for each other Plant and Zombie.
Tough_Beets.FlavorText: He grew up on the wrong side of the garden.

Weenie_Beanie.Name: Weenie Beanie
Weenie_Beanie.FlavorText: Prefers to be called "Vertically Challenged Beanie.

Barrel_of_Deadbeards.Name: Barrel of Deadbeards
Barrel_of_Deadbeards.Description: When destroyed: Do 1 damage to all Plants and Zombies, then make a [4a]/[3h] Captain Deadbeard here.
Barrel_of_Deadbeards.LongDescription: When destroyed: Do 1 damage to all Plants and Zombies, then make a [4a]/[3h] Captain Deadbeard here.

Captain_Flameface.Name: Captain Flameface
Captain_Flameface.FlavorText: You get your beard caught in the toaster ONE time, and it's all anyone can talk about...

Yeti_Lunchbox.Name: Yeti Lunchbox
Yeti_Lunchbox.Description: A Zombie gets [+1a]/[+1h]. If it is a Pet, it gets [+2a]/[+1h] instead.
Yeti_Lunchbox.LongDescription: A Zombie gets [+1a]/[+1h]. If it is a Pet, it gets [+2a]/[+1h] instead.
Yeti_Lunchbox.FlavorText: What's inside? A peanut butter and brains sandwich... with the crusts cut off.

Goat.Name: Goat
Goat.Description: Gets [+1a]/[+1h] when any kind of Goat is hurt.
Goat.LongDescription: This gets [+1a]/[+1h] when any kind of Goat is hurt.
Goat.FlavorText: Hungry... Smelly... A lot like a Zombie but with 100% more goat.

Teleport.Name: Teleport
Teleport.Description: You may play a Zombie when it's time for Tricks this turn. Draw a card.
Teleport.LongDescription: You may play a Zombie when it's time for Tricks this turn. \nDraw a card.

Punish-Shroom.Name: Punish-Shroom
Punish-Shroom.Description: When a Mushroom is destroyed, do 2 damage to a random Zombie or Zombie Hero.
Punish-Shroom.LongDescription: When a Mushroom is destroyed, do 2 damage to a random Zombie or Zombie Hero.
Punish-Shroom.FlavorText: Believes revenge is best served. Period.

Zombot_Stomp.Name: Zombot Stomp
Zombot_Stomp.FlavorText: Don't make him put his foot down!

Haunting_Ghost.Name: Haunting Ghost
Haunting_Ghost.FlavorText: Is he a Zombie? Is he a ghost? He refuses to be pigeonholed.

Swabbie.Name: Swabbie
Swabbie.FlavorText: When he's not fighting Plants, you'll find him swabbing the Zombot Plank Walker's poop deck.

Whack-a-Zombie.Name: Whack-a-Zombie
Whack-a-Zombie.Description: Destroy a Zombie with [3a] or less.
Whack-a-Zombie.LongDescription: Destroy a Zombie with [3a] or less.

Small-Nut.Name: Small-Nut
Small-Nut.FlavorText: A violin virtuoso, Small-Nut began taking lessons when he was still in the shell.

Button_Mushroom.Name: Button Mushroom
Button_Mushroom.FlavorText: Everyone's always telling her, "You're cute as a button!" But she's not just cute. She's smart and funny too.

Bellflower.Name: Bellflower
Bellflower.FlavorText: She wants to be friends with Snowdrop soooo badly, but she feels like she's always getting the cold shoulder.

Baseball_Zombie.Name: Baseball Zombie
Baseball_Zombie.FlavorText: Home run. Running for your home. It's all the same to him.

Skunk_Punk.Name: Skunk Punk
Skunk_Punk.FlavorText: Smelly Zombie is the only Zombie who really gets him, you know?

Hot_Dog_Imp.Name: Hot Dog Imp
Hot_Dog_Imp.FlavorText: He was THIS close to wearing the chicken costume, but darn it, Team Mascot Imp called it first.

Mushroom_Grotto.Name: Mushroom Grotto
Mushroom_Grotto.Description: When you play a Plant here, make a [1a]/[1h] Puff-Shroom with [teamup] in another random lane.
Mushroom_Grotto.LongDescription: When you play a Plant here, make a [1a]/[1h] Puff-Shroom with [teamup] in another random lane.
Mushroom_Grotto.FlavorText: Sometimes beautiful things grow out of the darkest places. Ponder that for a few moments.

Coffee_Grounds.Name: Coffee Grounds
Coffee_Grounds.FlavorText: Nothing wakes you up in the morning like extra attacks on Zombies. Well OK, coffee does.

Laser_Base_Alpha.Name: Laser Base Alpha
Laser_Base_Alpha.FlavorText: Zombies with LASERS. What could possibly go wrong?

Regifting_Zombie.Name: Regifting Zombie
Regifting_Zombie.Description: [Conjure] a Zombie with [+1a]/[+1h]. The Plant player [Conjures] a Plant with [-1a]/[-1h].
Regifting_Zombie.LongDescription: When played: [Conjure] a Zombie, and it gets [+1a]/[+1h]. The Plant player [Conjures] a Plant, and that Plant gets [-1a]/[-1h].
Regifting_Zombie.FlavorText: Regifting: Is it really an embarrassing social faux pas? Or is it just good ol' recycling?

Jack_O'_Lantern.Name: Jack O' Lantern
Jack_O'_Lantern.Description: [strikethrough]. This gets [+1a] when it hurts the Zombie Hero.
Jack_O'_Lantern.LongDescription: [strikethrough]\nThis gets [+1a] when it hurts the Zombie Hero.
Jack_O'_Lantern.FlavorText: I just love to get Zombies all fired up. If you catch my drift.

Leftovers.Name: Leftovers
Leftovers.FlavorText: Zombies love them almost as much as brains.

Turkey_Rider.Name: Turkey Rider
Turkey_Rider.FlavorText: He insists that, as far as modes of transportation go, turkeys outperform dolphins, walruses, and kangaroos any day.

Healthy_Treat.Name: Healthy Treat
Healthy_Treat.FlavorText: Great for Zombie Health. Like a vitamin only sweeter.

Sugary_Treat.Name: Sugary Treat
Sugary_Treat.FlavorText: Tooth decay: Not exactly a big concern for Zombies.

Trick-or-Treater.Name: Trick-or-Treater
Trick-or-Treater.Description: [gravestone]. When you play your first Trick each turn, [conjure] a [linktreat].
Trick-or-Treater.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nWhen you play your first Trick each turn, [conjure] a [linktreat].
Trick-or-Treater.FlavorText: Trick or treat? He is haunted by that question - and by an answer that continues to elude him.

Jolly_Holly.Name: Jolly Holly
Jolly_Holly.FlavorText: No exaggeration, she is ALWAYS in a great mood. Even when fighting Zombies. "What's not to love about saving the world?" she says.

Mayflower.Name: Mayflower
Mayflower.Description: [aquatic]. When this hurts the Zombie Hero, [conjure] a Corn, Squash, or Bean.
Mayflower.LongDescription: [aquatic]\nWhen this hurts the Zombie Hero, [conjure] a Corn, Squash, or Bean.
Mayflower.FlavorText: Do April showers bring Mayflowers? My goodness, isn't that a personal question!

Red_Stinger.Name: Red Stinger
Red_Stinger.Description: [teamup]. When played behind a Plant: This becomes [7a]/[3h].
Red_Stinger.LongDescription: [teamup]\n When played behind a Plant: This becomes [7a]/[3h].
Red_Stinger.FlavorText: I do stretching exercises every morning," he says. "It's important to stay physically and mentally nimble.

Corn_Dog.Name: Corn Dog
Corn_Dog.FlavorText: Who's a good vegetable? You are! Yes, you are!

Plantern.Name: Plantern
Plantern.Description: While in an Environment: This gets [+1a]/[+1h] and [truestrike].
Plantern.LongDescription: While in an Environment: This gets [+1a]/[+1h] and [truestrike].
Plantern.FlavorText: Past job experience includes: Shooing away creepy fog.

Spikeweed_Sector.Name: Spikeweed Sector
Spikeweed_Sector.Description: Before combat here: Do 2 damage to a Zombie here.
Spikeweed_Sector.LongDescription: Before combat here: Do 2 damage to a Zombie here.
Spikeweed_Sector.FlavorText: Quite similar to the region known as Pokey Province.

Cosmic_Nut.Name: Cosmic Nut
Cosmic_Nut.LongDescription: When played: [conjure] a Nut, and its [a] becomes [4a].
Cosmic_Nut.FlavorText: A staunch believer in numerology, he'll go on at length about the significance of the number 3 if you let him.

Photosynthesizer.Name: Photosynthesizer
Photosynthesizer.Description: A Plant gets [+2h]. [conjure] a Galactic Gardens card.
Photosynthesizer.LongDescription: A Plant gets [+2h].\n[conjure] a Galactic Gardens card.
Photosynthesizer.FlavorText: The galaxy is one beautiful melody, so play!

Starch-Lord.Name: Starch-Lord
Starch-Lord.Description: When you play a Root, both the Roots get [+1a]/[+1h]. Start of turn: [conjure] a Root.
Starch-Lord.LongDescription: When you play a Root, both the Roots get [+1a]/[+1h].\nStart of turn: [conjure] a Root.
Starch-Lord.FlavorText: His destiny is written in the starch.

Gravitree.Name: Gravitree
Gravitree.Description: [armored=1]. [untrickable]. When a Zombie is played, move it here.
Gravitree.LongDescription: [armored=1]  [untrickable]\nWhen a Zombie is played, move it here.
Gravitree.FlavorText: The apple doesn't fall far from the tree. Neither does anything else.

Body-Gourd.Name: Body-Gourd
Body-Gourd.Description: [aquatic], [teamup]. Fill your Super-Block Meter to full.
Body-Gourd.LongDescription: [aquatic], [teamup]\nWhen played: Fill your Super-Block Meter to full.
Body-Gourd.FlavorText: He moonlights as a decorative center piece during the fall.

Pecanolith.Name: Pecanolith
Pecanolith.Description: All Plants and Zombies attack using their [h] instead of their [a].
Pecanolith.LongDescription: All Plants and Zombies attack using their [h] instead of their [a].
Pecanolith.FlavorText: No one knows where he came from. He just appeared one day. But everyone who comes in contact with him feels... changed somehow.

Health-Nut.Name: Health-Nut
Health-Nut.Description: This attacks using its [h] instead of its [a].
Health-Nut.LongDescription: This attacks using its [h] instead of its [a].

Pear_Cub.Name: Pear Cub
Pear_Cub.Description: [aquatic]. When destroyed: Make a [5a]/[4h] Grizzly Pear with [aquatic] here and all Fruit Plants get [1a]/[1h].
Pear_Cub.LongDescription: [aquatic]\nWhen destroyed: Make a [5a]/[4h] Grizzly Pear with [aquatic] here and all Fruit Plants get [1a]/[1h].
Pear_Cub.FlavorText: So cute and cuddly and... wait, what's that growling sound?

Grizzly_Pear.Name: Grizzly Pear
Grizzly_Pear.FlavorText: It's true what they say, "Never get between a Grizzly Pear and her cub." Doubly true for Zombies.

Garlic.Name: Garlic
Garlic.Description: [teamup]. When a Zombie hurts this, move that Zombie to the left. If it's a Vimpire, destroy it.
Garlic.LongDescription: [teamup]\nWhen a Zombie hurts this, move that Zombie to the left. If it's a Vimpire, destroy it.
Garlic.FlavorText: Vimpires. They're the worst. I don't like to use the word 'hate' but yeah, I hate 'em.

Galacta-Cactus.Name: Galacta-Cactus
Galacta-Cactus.Description: [truestrike]. When destroyed: Do 1 damage to everything.
Galacta-Cactus.FlavorText: I take pity on no one. For I am Galacta-Cactus!

Invasive_Species.Name: Invasive Species
Invasive_Species.FlavorText: Call me a 'weed.' Go on. I consider it a compliment.

Cosmic_Mushroom.Name: Cosmic Mushroom
Cosmic_Mushroom.LongDescription: When played: [conjure] a Mushroom, and it gets [+2a].
Cosmic_Mushroom.FlavorText: He's far out all right. Like, waaaay far out.

Lava_Guava.Name: Lava Guava
Lava_Guava.Description: Do 2 damage to each Zombie here and next door. If played on the Ground, make [linklava] here.
Lava_Guava.LongDescription: Do 2 damage to each Zombie here and next door.\nIf played on the Ground, make [linklava] here.
Lava_Guava.FlavorText: I try to stay cool, I really do. But Zombies! Man, they make me blow my top!

Hot_Lava.Name: Hot Lava
Hot_Lava.Description: Before combat here: Do 1 damage to each Plant and Zombie here.
Hot_Lava.LongDescription: Before combat here: Do 1 damage to each Plant and Zombie here.
Hot_Lava.FlavorText: Lava has no loyalty. It's just hot. It just IS.

Banana_Launcher.Name: Banana Launcher
Banana_Launcher.FlavorText: He only knows one word. But it's a good one.

Astro-Shroom.Name: Astro-Shroom
Astro-Shroom.Description: [truestrike]. When you play a Plant, do 1 damage to the Zombie Hero.
Astro-Shroom.LongDescription: [truestrike]\nWhen you play a Plant, do 1 damage to the Zombie Hero.
Astro-Shroom.FlavorText: He's had good meetings with a lot of smaller asteroids. They really made an impression.

Sonic_Bloom.Name: Sonic Bloom
Sonic_Bloom.Description: Do 1 damage to the Zombie Hero for each Plant.
Sonic_Bloom.LongDescription: When played: Do 1 damage to the Zombie Hero for each Plant.
Sonic_Bloom.FlavorText: Victory faster than the speed of sound.

Molekale.Name: Molekale
Molekale.Description: Each other Plant transforms into a random Plant that costs [1s] more.
Molekale.LongDescription: When played: Each other Plant transforms into a random Plant that costs [1s] more.
Molekale.FlavorText: And you thought spinach made you strong. Please. I am spinach times infinity.

Electric_Blueberry.Name: Electric Blueberry
Electric_Blueberry.Description: After combat here: Do 6 damage to a random Zombie or the Zombie Hero.
Electric_Blueberry.LongDescription: After combat here: Do 6 damage to a random Zombie or the Zombie Hero.
Electric_Blueberry.FlavorText: Does she strike a "random" Zombie with her lightning? Really? Or is she settling an old, unspoken score?

High-Voltage_Currant.Name: High-Voltage Currant
High-Voltage_Currant.Description: Gets [+1a] when another Berry does damage. [conjure] a Berry.
High-Voltage_Currant.LongDescription: This gets [+1a] when another Berry does damage. \nWhen played: [conjure] a Berry.
High-Voltage_Currant.FlavorText: These trouble makers are just asking to get grounded.

Blooming_Heart.Name: Blooming Heart
Blooming_Heart.Description: When this does damage, it gets [+1a].
Blooming_Heart.LongDescription: When this does damage, it gets [+1a].
Blooming_Heart.FlavorText: Sometimes we hurt the ones we love. Blooming Heart knows this all too well.

Reincarnation.Name: Reincarnation
Reincarnation.Description: While in your hand: At end of turn, this transforms into a random Plant with [+1a]/[+1h]. It keeps this ability.
Reincarnation.LongDescription: While in your hand: At end of turn, this transforms into a random Plant with [+1a]/[+1h]. It keeps this ability.
Reincarnation.FlavorText: You never know what the next life has in store for you," she says. "So get the most out of this one while you can.

Sweet_Pea.Name: Sweet Pea
Sweet_Pea.Description: Move a Zombie to this lane.
Sweet_Pea.LongDescription: When played: Move a Zombie to this lane.
Sweet_Pea.FlavorText: Zombies may only have four teeth left, but one of them's a sweet tooth.

Vegetation_Mutation.Name: Vegetation Mutation
Vegetation_Mutation.Description: All Plants on Heights and Environments get [+2a]/[+2h].
Vegetation_Mutation.LongDescription: All Plants on Heights and Environments get [+2a]/[+2h].

The_Red_Plant-It.Name: The Red Plant-It
The_Red_Plant-It.FlavorText: It may seem an inhospitable place for Plants, but with a little TLC and some patience, it'll grow more than just potatoes. Much more.

Cosmic_Pea.Name: Cosmic Pea
Cosmic_Pea.LongDescription: [doublestrike]\nWhen played: [conjure] a Pea, and it gets [doublestrike].
Cosmic_Pea.FlavorText: The cosmos is so big and a pea is so small. The juxtaposition just really makes me think, you know?

Banana_Peel.Name: Banana Peel
Banana_Peel.FlavorText: A slapstick comedy staple that, somehow, the Zombies never see coming.

Cosmoss.Name: Cosmoss
Cosmoss.Description: When an Environment is played, this gets [+2a]/[+2h].
Cosmoss.LongDescription: When an Environment is played, this gets [+2a]/[+2h].
Cosmoss.FlavorText: He's Peel deGrass Lichen's biggest fan.

Moonbean.Name: Moonbean
Moonbean.Description: When this does damage, shuffle two [linkmagicbeanstalks] into your deck.
Moonbean.LongDescription: When this does damage, shuffle two [linkmagicbeanstalks] into your deck.
Moonbean.FlavorText: She and Sunflower are besties. It's just too bad their schedules make it hard for them to get together.

Onion_Rings.Name: Onion Rings
Onion_Rings.Description: Each Plant in your hand becomes [4a]/[4h].
Onion_Rings.LongDescription: When played: Each Plant in your hand becomes [4a]/[4h].
Onion_Rings.FlavorText: So powerful it makes you cry.

Captain_Cucumber.Name: Captain Cucumber
Captain_Cucumber.Description: Cards you [conjure] cost [1s] less. When this does damage, [conjure] a Legendary card.
Captain_Cucumber.LongDescription: Cards you [conjure] cost [1s] less.\nWhen this does damage, [conjure] a Legendary card.
Captain_Cucumber.FlavorText: He's steered his crew through many a pickle.

Clique_Peas.Name: Clique Peas
Clique_Peas.Description: Shuffle two Clique Peas into your deck. For the rest of the game, all Clique Peas get [+1a]/[+1h] and cost [+1s].
Clique_Peas.LongDescription: When played: Shuffle two Clique Peas into your deck. For the rest of the game, all Clique Peas get [+1a]/[+1h] and cost [+1s].

Lily_of_the_Valley.Name: Lily of the Valley
Lily_of_the_Valley.Description: When you play a Plant on the Heights, that Plant gets [+2a]/[+2h].
Lily_of_the_Valley.LongDescription: When you play a Plant on the Heights, that Plant gets [+2a]/[+2h].
Lily_of_the_Valley.FlavorText: She's always trying to elevate her friends. She's good like that.

Snake_Grass.Name: Snake Grass
Snake_Grass.Description: [aquatic]. Start of turn: Make another Snake Grass in the lane to the right.
Snake_Grass.LongDescription: [aquatic]\nStart of turn: Make another Snake Grass in the lane to the right.
Snake_Grass.FlavorText: Snakes. Why'd it have to be snakes?

Pod_Fighter.Name: Pod Fighter
Pod_Fighter.Description: This does a Bonus Attack when you play a Plant here or next door.
Pod_Fighter.LongDescription: This does a Bonus Attack when you play a Plant here or next door.
Pod_Fighter.FlavorText: They're just trying to create peas in our time.

Laser_Cattail.Name: Laser Cattail
Laser_Cattail.Description: [aquatic], [teamup]. This gets [+1a]/[+1h] when you play a Plant here.
Laser_Cattail.LongDescription: [aquatic], [teamup]\nThis gets [+1a]/[+1h] when you play a Plant here.
Laser_Cattail.FlavorText: He's really good at entertaining himself.

Leaf_Blower.Name: Leaf Blower
Leaf_Blower.Description: [aquatic]. When played in an Environment: [bounce] a Zombie or Gravestone.
Leaf_Blower.LongDescription: [aquatic]\nWhen played in an Environment: [bounce] a Zombie or Gravestone.
Leaf_Blower.FlavorText: You wanna keep your lawn tidy? Tired of lookin' at those unsightly Zombies? Then I'M your guy.

Planet_of_the_Grapes.Name: Planet of the Grapes
Planet_of_the_Grapes.Description: When a Plant here hurts the Zombie Hero, draw a card.
Planet_of_the_Grapes.LongDescription: When a Plant here hurts the Zombie Hero, draw a card.
Planet_of_the_Grapes.FlavorText: How this planet came to be? It's another of life's grape mysteries.

Cosmic_Bean.Name: Cosmic Bean
Cosmic_Bean.LongDescription: [teamup]\nWhen played: [conjure] a Bean, and it gets [teamup].

Mars_Flytrap.Name: Mars Flytrap
Mars_Flytrap.Description: When this hurts the Zombie Hero, steal a section from their Super-Block Meter.
Mars_Flytrap.LongDescription: When this hurts the Zombie Hero, steal a section from their Super-Block Meter.
Mars_Flytrap.FlavorText: He loves Venus Flytrap, but sometimes they see things SO differently!

Sap-Fling.Name: Sap-Fling
Sap-Fling.FlavorText: He dates a lot of different branches, but nothing ever sticks.

Cool_Bean.Name: Cool Bean
Cool_Bean.FlavorText: Chance of meeting Gravestones? Never tell me the odds!

Bog_of_Enlightenment.Name: Bog of Enlightenment
Bog_of_Enlightenment.Description: Plants here that are [aquatic] get [+2a]. Zombies here that aren't [aquatic] get [-2a].
Bog_of_Enlightenment.LongDescription: Plants here that are [aquatic] get [+2a].\nZombies here that aren't [aquatic] get [-2a].
Bog_of_Enlightenment.FlavorText: Good for Plants, it is. Good for Zombies, it is not!

Shooting_Starfruit.Name: Shooting Starfruit
Shooting_Starfruit.LongDescription: This attacks in all five lanes.
Shooting_Starfruit.FlavorText: When you see a Shooting Starfruit, make a wish, any wish! Any wish that involves takin' down Zombies, that is.

Dark_Matter_Dragonfruit.Name: Dark Matter Dragonfruit
Dark_Matter_Dragonfruit.FlavorText: Their ancestors were hunted to the depths of space. Now their descendants are back for cold, fruity vengeance.

Melon-Pult.Name: Melon-Pult
Melon-Pult.FlavorText: People who live in grass houses shouldn't throw stones. But melons, sure, why not?

Spyris.Name: Spyris
Spyris.Description: [aquatic]. You can tap Gravestones to see which Zombies are hiding in them.
Spyris.LongDescription: [aquatic]\nYou can tap Gravestones to see which Zombies are hiding in them.
Spyris.FlavorText: You can't hide anything from her. Don't even try. She'll get inside your HEAD.

Apple-Saucer.Name: Apple-Saucer
Apple-Saucer.Description: When played: If you made at least [6s] this turn, this gets [strikethrough].
Apple-Saucer.LongDescription: When played: If you made at least [6s] this turn, this gets [strikethrough].
Apple-Saucer.FlavorText: Watchful Quasar Wizards sometimes spot an Unidentified Fruiting Object.

Wing-Nut.Name: Wing-Nut
Wing-Nut.FlavorText: Firmly believes that Elvis is alive, Zombies never walked on the Moon, and that Dr. Zomboss is secretly studying aliens at Area 22. Crazy!

Venus_Flytraplanet.Name: Venus Flytraplanet
Venus_Flytraplanet.Description: When a Plant here does damage and survives, heal your Hero that much.
Venus_Flytraplanet.LongDescription: When a Plant here does damage and survives, heal your Hero that much.

Cosmic_Flower.Name: Cosmic Flower
Cosmic_Flower.LongDescription: [strikethrough]\nWhen played: [conjure] a Flower, and it gets [strikethrough].
Cosmic_Flower.FlavorText: She enjoys the simple things in life - hanging out with friends, fighting Zombies, and basking in cosmic rays.

Heartichoke.Name: Heartichoke
Heartichoke.Description: When a Plant or your Hero is healed, do that much damage to the Zombie Hero.
Heartichoke.LongDescription: When a Plant or your Hero is healed, do that much damage to the Zombie Hero.
Heartichoke.FlavorText: She's a sweetheart, she really is. But fighting Zombies...it's made her hard.

Banana_Split.Name: Banana Split
Banana_Split.Description: When destroyed: Make two [linkhalfbananas] next door.
Banana_Split.FlavorText: I don't want to brag, but hanging out in a tub full of ice cream all day... not a bad gig if you can get it.

Half-Banana.Name: Half-Banana
Half-Banana.Description: When destroyed: All Fruits in your hand get [+1a]/[+1h].
Half-Banana.LongDescription: When destroyed: All Fruits in your hand get [+1a]/[+1h].
Half-Banana.FlavorText: Have you met my better half? She's around here somewhere.

Solar_Winds.Name: Solar Winds
Solar_Winds.Description: End of Turn: If there are no Zombies here, make a [linksunflower] here.
Solar_Winds.LongDescription: End of Turn: If there are no Zombies here, make a [linksunflower] here.
Solar_Winds.FlavorText: There's something in the wind. Sunflower seeds, in fact.

Astro_Vera.Name: Astro Vera
Astro_Vera.Description: Increase your Hero's maximum [h] by 10. Heal your Hero for 10.
Astro_Vera.LongDescription: When played: Increase your Hero's maximum [h] by 10. Heal your Hero for 10.
Astro_Vera.FlavorText: Your Hero will feel out of this world. And so will your skin.

Tactical_Cuke.Name: Tactical Cuke
Tactical_Cuke.Description: Destroy all Plants and Zombies on the Ground.
Tactical_Cuke.LongDescription: Destroy all Plants and Zombies on the Ground.
Tactical_Cuke.FlavorText: He comes from a long line of very precise cucumbers.

Sun-Shroom.Name: Sun-Shroom
Sun-Shroom.Description: [teamup]. Start of turn: You get [+1s] this turn and this transforms into a [linksunshroomier].
Sun-Shroom.LongDescription: [teamup]\nStart of turn: You get [+1s] this turn and this transforms into a [linksunshroomier].
Sun-Shroom.FlavorText: Fun in the Sun? That's for other Plants. I just make the stuff. I don't actually enjoy it.

Toadstool.Name: Toadstool
Toadstool.Description: Destroy a Zombie here with [4a] or less. Start of turn: You get [+1s] this turn.
Toadstool.LongDescription: When played: Destroy a Zombie here with [4a] or less.\nStart of turn: You get [+1s] this turn.
Toadstool.FlavorText: Toadstool can't stand being idle. When there's work to be done, she's always the first to hop on it.

Haunted_Pumpking.Name: Haunted Pumpking
Haunted_Pumpking.LongDescription: When played: The Zombie player [conjures] a Monster.
Haunted_Pumpking.FlavorText: For generations, the Pumpkings have kept their realms safe from a terrible curse. Tonight, they finally face their greatest fear.

Kitchen_Sink_Zombie.Name: Kitchen Sink Zombie
Kitchen_Sink_Zombie.FlavorText: He's got everything but the - no wait, he's got that too.

Alien_Ooze.Name: Alien Ooze
Alien_Ooze.Description: A Plant gets [-3a]/[-3h]. If it's on heights or an Environment, it gets [-6a]/[-6h] instead.
Alien_Ooze.LongDescription: A Plant gets [-3a]/[-3h]. If it's on heights or an Environment, it gets [-6a]/[-6h] instead.

Area_22.Name: Area 22
Area_22.FlavorText: Zombies from outer space? What an absurd conspiracy theory! Now move along. Nothing to see here." - Dr. Zomboss

Cosmic_Yeti.Name: Cosmic Yeti
Cosmic_Yeti.Description: [conjure] a Pet, and it gets [+1a]/[+1h]. End of turn: [bounce] this Yeti.
Cosmic_Yeti.LongDescription: When played: [conjure] a Pet, and it gets [+1a]/[+1h].\nEnd of turn: [bounce] this Yeti.
Cosmic_Yeti.FlavorText: He's hoping they name a constellation after him. "The Big Yeti" does have a ring to it.

Escape_through_Time.Name: Escape through Time
Escape_through_Time.Description: A Zombie can't be hurt this turn. [conjure] a History card.
Escape_through_Time.LongDescription: A Zombie can't be hurt this turn.\n[conjure] a History card.
Escape_through_Time.FlavorText: Possible side effects include: the creation of a temporal paradox, the unraveling of the fabric of reality, erasing your entire existence, a mild foot rash.

Surfer_Zombie.Name: Surfer Zombie
Surfer_Zombie.FlavorText: He used to hang 10 with the best of them, but ever since he lost that toe to a shark he hasn't been able to hang more than 9.

Total_Eclipse.Name: Total Eclipse
Total_Eclipse.FlavorText: Zombies love a good eclipse. They usually celebrate by eating Plants. And brains.

Interstellar_Bounty_Hunter.Name: Interstellar Bounty Hunter
Interstellar_Bounty_Hunter.Description: [hunt], [frenzy]. When this destroys a Plant, draw a card.
Interstellar_Bounty_Hunter.LongDescription: [hunt], [frenzy]\nWhen this destroys a Plant, draw a card.
Interstellar_Bounty_Hunter.FlavorText: If you have a bounty on your head, she won't stop until she eats your brains. It's not personal. It's just business.

Supernova_Gargantuar.Name: Supernova Gargantuar
Supernova_Gargantuar.Description: [frenzy]. When a Gargantuar destroys a Plant, destroy all copies of that Plant.
Supernova_Gargantuar.LongDescription: [frenzy]\nWhen a Gargantuar destroys a Plant, destroy all copies of that Plant.
Supernova_Gargantuar.FlavorText: This one's got a real temper on him. When he decides to take out a Plant...it's brutal. Just brutal.

Secret_Agent.Name: Secret Agent
Secret_Agent.FlavorText: He likes his brains shaken, not stirred.

Synchronized_Swimmer.Name: Synchronized Swimmer
Synchronized_Swimmer.Description: [aquatic]. This Zombie copies the [a] and [h] of another Zombie.
Synchronized_Swimmer.LongDescription: [aquatic]\nWhen played: This Zombie copies the [a] and [h] of another Zombie.
Synchronized_Swimmer.FlavorText: It takes a lot of practice for two Zombies' heads to fall off at the exact same time.

Energy_Drink_Zombie.Name: Energy Drink Zombie
Energy_Drink_Zombie.Description: [frenzy]. Start of Tricks: This gets [+1a]/[+1h] and moves to a random lane.
Energy_Drink_Zombie.LongDescription: [frenzy]\nStart of Tricks: This gets [+1a]/[+1h] and moves to a random lane.
Energy_Drink_Zombie.FlavorText: He can quit any time he wants.

Overstuffed_Zombie.Name: Overstuffed Zombie
Overstuffed_Zombie.Description: [Hunt]. When this destroys a Plant, it heals to full and heals your Hero for 2.
Overstuffed_Zombie.LongDescription: [Hunt]. When this destroys a Plant and survives, \nit heals to full and heals your Hero for 2.
Overstuffed_Zombie.FlavorText: His cholesterol level is off the charts, and yet he seems to be in remarkably good Health.

Cryo-Brain.Name: Cryo-Brain
Cryo-Brain.Description: You get [+1b] for the rest of the game.
Cryo-Brain.LongDescription: You get [+1b] for the rest of the game.
Cryo-Brain.FlavorText: Putting brains on ice is the best way to keep them fresh. Ask any Zombie.

Moonwalker.Name: Moonwalker
Moonwalker.Description: When played on Heights or an Environment: This gets [+2a]/[+2h].
Moonwalker.LongDescription: When played on Heights or an Environment: This gets [+2a]/[+2h].
Moonwalker.FlavorText: That's one small nibble for Zombies, one giant bite for Zombiekind.

Medulla_Nebula.Name: Medulla Nebula
Medulla_Nebula.Description: When you play a Zombie here, you get [+2b] this turn.
Medulla_Nebula.LongDescription: When you play a Zombie here, you get [+2b] this turn.
Medulla_Nebula.FlavorText: Zombies often find brains in space. It's usually the space between your ears.

Triplication.Name: Triplication
Triplication.Description: [conjure] an Imp, a Zombie, and a Gargantuar.
Triplication.LongDescription: [conjure] an Imp, a Zombie, and a Gargantuar.
Triplication.FlavorText: An Imp, a Zombie, and Gargantuar walk into a bar...

Cosmic_Scientist.Name: Cosmic Scientist
Cosmic_Scientist.Description: [truestrike]. [conjure] a Science card, and it gets [truestrike].
Cosmic_Scientist.LongDescription: [truestrike]\nWhen played: [conjure] a Science card, and it gets [truestrike].
Cosmic_Scientist.FlavorText: He has no idea what's in the beakers. He just likes to mix them together until they go BOOM!

Wormhole_Gatekeeper.Name: Wormhole Gatekeeper
Wormhole_Gatekeeper.Description: Cards either player [Conjures] cost 1 less. Start of turn: Each player [Conjures] a card.
Wormhole_Gatekeeper.LongDescription: Cards either player [Conjures] cost 1 less. Start of turn: Each player [Conjures] a card.
Wormhole_Gatekeeper.FlavorText: Stand here and guard this gate with your unlife," she was told. And that's what she's been doing ever since.

Neutron_Imp.Name: Neutron Imp
Neutron_Imp.Description: When an Environment is played, this does a Bonus Attack.
Neutron_Imp.LongDescription: When an Environment is played, this does a Bonus Attack.
Neutron_Imp.FlavorText: He's not small, he's just very compact.

Transformation_Station.Name: Transformation Station
Transformation_Station.Description: Start of turn: Transform the Zombie here into a random Zombie that costs [1b] more.
Transformation_Station.LongDescription: Start of turn: Transform the Zombie here into a random Zombie that costs [1b] more.
Transformation_Station.FlavorText: According to the Transformation Station brochure, every Zombie who visits is guaranteed to shuffle away feeling like a brand new Zombie.

Teleportation_Zombie.Name: Teleportation Zombie
Teleportation_Zombie.Description: [gravestone], [truestrike]. You can play Zombies when it's time for Tricks.
Teleportation_Zombie.LongDescription: [gravestone], [truestrike]\nYou can play Zombies when it's time for Tricks.
Teleportation_Zombie.FlavorText: The phone cord stretches to another dimension.

Interdimensional_Zombie.Name: Interdimensional Zombie
Interdimensional_Zombie.Description: When you play a Science card, this transforms into a random Zombie that costs [3b].
Interdimensional_Zombie.LongDescription: When you play a Science card, this transforms into a random Zombie that costs [3b].
Interdimensional_Zombie.FlavorText: In a parallel dimension, this Zombie is a Space Pirate. In another he's a Trash Can Zombie. Turns out, little choices in life can make a big difference.

Zombology_Teacher.Name: Zombology Teacher
Zombology_Teacher.FlavorText: If you don't pay attention in class, you'll never improve your brains...

Thinking_Cap.Name: Thinking Cap
Thinking_Cap.FlavorText: Only the best and brainiest University Zombies graduate to using full-fledged Superpowers.

Leprechaun_Imp.Name: Leprechaun Imp
Leprechaun_Imp.LongDescription: When played: Shuffle a [linkpotofgold] into your deck.
Leprechaun_Imp.FlavorText: When he offers to grant you a wish, do not wish for infinite wishes. It just doesn't work like that.

Disco-Naut.Name: Disco-Naut
Disco-Naut.FlavorText: Nothing focuses your aim like the super-sick wailing of a space keytar solo.

Space_Ninja.Name: Space Ninja
Space_Ninja.Description: While in an Environment: The first time each turn this does damage, do 1 damage to each Plant.
Space_Ninja.LongDescription: While in an Environment: The first time each turn this does damage, do 1 damage to each Plant.
Space_Ninja.FlavorText: You will never hear him coming in the vacuum of space.

Meteor_Z.Name: Meteor Z
Meteor_Z.FlavorText: Huge-Gigantacus drove Meteor Z deep into the Earth, creating a tunnel to a hidden world of strange creatures...but what's down there???

Cosmic_Dancer.Name: Cosmic Dancer
Cosmic_Dancer.Description: [overshoot=2]. [conjure] a Dancing card, and it gets [overshoot=2].
Cosmic_Dancer.LongDescription: [overshoot=2]\nWhen played: [conjure] a Dancing card, and it gets [overshoot=2].
Cosmic_Dancer.FlavorText: Across the cosmos, the passion for dance is the only universal language.

Final_Mission.Name: Final Mission
Final_Mission.Description: Destroy a Zombie. Then do 4 damage to a Plant.
Final_Mission.LongDescription: Destroy a Zombie. Then do 4 damage to a Plant.
Final_Mission.FlavorText: The round-trip ticket is the same price as the one-way.

Quasar_Wizard.Name: Quasar Wizard
Quasar_Wizard.Description: When played next to a Zombie: [conjure] a Superpower.
Quasar_Wizard.LongDescription: When played next to a Zombie: [conjure] a Superpower.
Quasar_Wizard.FlavorText: You can call him Quazard for short.

Loose_Cannon.Name: Loose Cannon
Loose_Cannon.FlavorText: His friends keep telling him it's too dangerous, but he never listens. He's having a blast.

Moon_Base_Z.Name: Moon Base Z
Moon_Base_Z.FlavorText: Zombies landed on the Moon? Many believe it's nothing but a conspiracy theory, and yet, here's the proof.

Binary_Stars.Name: Binary Stars
Binary_Stars.Description: [gravestone]. All your cards do double damage.
Binary_Stars.FlavorText: He's a Gemini and so is she. Which explains so much, right?

Gas_Giant.Name: Gas Giant
Gas_Giant.Description: When hurt: Do 1 damage to each other Plant and Zombie. When destroyed: Do 5 damage to the Plant Hero.
Gas_Giant.LongDescription: When hurt: Do 1 damage to each other Plant and Zombie.\nWhen destroyed: Do 5 damage to the Plant Hero.
Gas_Giant.FlavorText: There isn't a fart joke he hasn't heard.

Stupid_Cupid.Name: Stupid Cupid
Stupid_Cupid.Description: Do 1 damage to a Plant. That Plant has [0a] this turn.
Stupid_Cupid.LongDescription: When played: Do 1 damage to a Plant. That Plant has [0a] this turn.
Stupid_Cupid.FlavorText: What's love got to do with it? Honestly, he has no idea.

Gargantuar-Throwing_Imp.Name: Gargantuar-Throwing Imp
Gargantuar-Throwing_Imp.Description: When hurt: Make a random Gargantuar that costs [5b] in a random lane.
Gargantuar-Throwing_Imp.LongDescription: When hurt: Make a random Gargantuar that costs [5b] in a random lane.
Gargantuar-Throwing_Imp.FlavorText: When lifting a Gargantuar, always bend at the knees. He learned this the hard way.

Screen_Door_Zombie.Name: Screen Door Zombie
Screen_Door_Zombie.Description: [gravestone]. When revealed: This can't be hurt this turn.
Screen_Door_Zombie.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nWhen revealed: This can't be hurt this turn.
Screen_Door_Zombie.FlavorText: Little known fact: He carries a door to protect himself from solar radiation.

Celestial_Custodian.Name: Celestial Custodian
Celestial_Custodian.Description: When played in an Environment: Destroy a Plant with [3a] or less.
Celestial_Custodian.LongDescription: When played in an Environment: Destroy a Plant with [3a] or less.
Celestial_Custodian.FlavorText: Don't call him a "Space Janitor." He's a "Celestial Custodian" and darn proud of it.

Cone_Zone.Name: Cone Zone
Cone_Zone.FlavorText: You are about to enter another dimension. A dimension not only of sight and sound, but of cones.

Cosmic_Sports_Star.Name: Cosmic Sports Star
Cosmic_Sports_Star.Description: [conjure] a Sports card, and it costs [2b] less.
Cosmic_Sports_Star.LongDescription: When played: [conjure] a Sports card, and it costs [2b] less.
Cosmic_Sports_Star.FlavorText: He's been named Most Valuable Zombie of the Galaxy two years in a row!

Biodome_Botanist.Name: Biodome Botanist
Biodome_Botanist.LongDescription: When played: Make a [1a]/[1h] Plant with no abilities.
Biodome_Botanist.FlavorText: Growing Plants in Space? Some of his fellow Zombies think he's crazy, but others appreciate the effort.

Planetary_Gladiator.Name: Planetary Gladiator
Planetary_Gladiator.Description: [armored=1]. If your Hero would get hurt, this gets hurt instead.
Planetary_Gladiator.LongDescription: [armored=1]\nIf your Hero would get hurt, this gets hurt instead.
Planetary_Gladiator.FlavorText: He's still not sure if he should defend Pluto or not.

Going_Viral.Name: Going Viral
Going_Viral.Description: All Zombies get [+1a]/[+1h] and [frenzy]. Shuffle three Going Viral cards into your deck. Draw a card.
