Going_Viral.LongDescription: All Zombies get [+1a]/[+1h] and [frenzy].\nShuffle three Going Viral cards into your deck.\nDraw a card.
Going_Viral.FlavorText: Though Zombies can't get ill, this plague is totally sick.

Black_Hole.Name: Black Hole
Black_Hole.Description: Plants here get [-1a]. When a Plant is played, move it here.
Black_Hole.LongDescription: Plants here get [-1a].\nWhen a Plant is played, move it here.
Black_Hole.FlavorText: Plants usually like being planted in holes. Black holes? Not so much.

Intergalactic_Warlord.Name: Intergalactic Warlord
Intergalactic_Warlord.Description: For the rest of the game, all Zombies get [+1a]/[+1h].
Intergalactic_Warlord.LongDescription: When played: For the rest of the game, all Zombies get [+1a]/[+1h].
Intergalactic_Warlord.FlavorText: In space Zombie circles, he's a very powerful figure. Just don't talk about him in front of Huge-Gigantacus. There's some jealousy there.

Zombot_Battlecruiser_5000.Name: Zombot Battlecruiser 5000
Zombot_Battlecruiser_5000.Description: [gravestone]. When revealed: Zombies can't be hurt this turn.
Zombot_Battlecruiser_5000.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nWhen revealed: Zombies can't be hurt this turn.
Zombot_Battlecruiser_5000.FlavorText: Not space legal in 35 different galaxies.

Defensive_End.Name: Defensive End
Defensive_End.FlavorText: Someone once told him the best defense is a good offence. He disagrees. Da fence he like best is da one he SMASH through.

Genetic_Experiment.Name: Genetic Experiment
Genetic_Experiment.Description: Start of Tricks: This gets [+1a]/[+1h] if there's a Zombie next door.
Genetic_Experiment.LongDescription: Start of Tricks: This gets [+1a]/[+1h] if there's a Zombie next door.
Genetic_Experiment.FlavorText: Pickled Zombie is the best kind of Zombie.

Gargologist.Name: Gargologist
Gargologist.FlavorText: After years of studying Gargantuars in the wild, she's dedicated herself to telling the world they're just misunderstood gentle giants. So far, nobody's buying it.

Ducky_Tube_Zombie.Name: Ducky Tube Zombie
Ducky_Tube_Zombie.Description: [aquatic]. This gets [+1a]/[+1h] when it hurts the Plant Hero.
Ducky_Tube_Zombie.LongDescription: [aquatic]\nThis gets [+1a]/[+1h] when it hurts the Plant Hero.
Ducky_Tube_Zombie.FlavorText: Zombie Ducky, joy of joys. When it squeezes, you make noise!

Ice_Pirate.Name: Ice Pirate
Ice_Pirate.Description: [gravestone]. When revealed in an Environment: [freeze] a Plant.
Ice_Pirate.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nWhen revealed in an Environment: [freeze] a Plant.
Ice_Pirate.FlavorText: You wouldn't believe how many brains a chunk of space ice goes for on the black market. Let's just say, she's rolling in gray matter.

Graveyard.Name: Graveyard
Graveyard.Description: Zombies played here are Gravestones. When a Zombie is revealed from a [gravestone] here, it gets [+1a].
Graveyard.LongDescription: Zombies played here are Gravestones.\nWhen a Zombie is revealed from a [gravestone] here, it gets [+1a].
Graveyard.FlavorText: Super Brainz always wanted a house with a nice yard.

Cosmic_Imp.Name: Cosmic Imp
Cosmic_Imp.LongDescription: [deadly]\nWhen played: [conjure] an Imp, and it gets [deadly].
Cosmic_Imp.FlavorText: When he gazes out at the stars, he feels small. Because he's an Imp.

Dr._Spacetime.Name: Dr. Spacetime
Dr._Spacetime.Description: Cards you [conjure] cost [1b] less. When this hurts the Plant Hero, [conjure] a Galactic Gardens card.
Dr._Spacetime.LongDescription: Cards you [conjure] cost [1b] less. When this hurts the Plant Hero, [conjure] a Galactic Gardens card.
Dr._Spacetime.FlavorText: He insists it's more than just a screwdriver. Much more.

Space_Pirate.Name: Space Pirate
Space_Pirate.Description: [ambush=2]. This moves to a random lane when a Plant is played here.
Space_Pirate.LongDescription: [ambush=2]\nThis moves to a random lane when a Plant is played here.
Space_Pirate.FlavorText: At first he just dabbled in space piracy, but then he got hooked.

Space_Cowboy.Name: Space Cowboy
Space_Cowboy.Description: [aquatic], [strikethrough]. This Zombie moves to the right when it hurts the Plant Hero.
Space_Cowboy.LongDescription: [aquatic], [strikethrough]\nThis Zombie moves to the right when it hurts the Plant Hero.
Space_Cowboy.FlavorText: Only in the big wide sky will he find Serenity.

Cryo-Yeti.Name: Cryo-Yeti
Cryo-Yeti.Description: [gravestone]. Gets [+2a]/[+2h] when a Plant or Zombie is frozen. When revealed: [freeze] a Plant.
Cryo-Yeti.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nThis gets [+2a]/[+2h] when a Plant or Zombie is frozen.\nWhen revealed: [freeze] a Plant.
Cryo-Yeti.FlavorText: Freezing Plants in the far reaches of Space is not what he'd imagined he'd spend his life doing. But as the old Yeti saying goes, "When life hands you snow, you make snow cones.

Cheese_Cutter.Name: Cheese Cutter
Cheese_Cutter.Description: When this hurts the Plant Hero: [conjure] a Gourmet card, and it costs [1b] less.
Cheese_Cutter.LongDescription: When this hurts the Plant Hero: [conjure] a Gourmet card, and it costs [1b] less.
Cheese_Cutter.FlavorText: Is that the exquisite scent of an aged Camembert, or just rotting flesh?

Zombie_High_Diver.Name: Zombie High Diver
Zombie_High_Diver.Description: [gravestone]. When revealed on Heights: This moves to the Water and gets [+1a]/[+1h].
Zombie_High_Diver.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nWhen revealed on Heights: This moves to the Water and gets [+1a]/[+1h].
Zombie_High_Diver.FlavorText: He used to be afraid of heights ... and water. True story.

Imposter.Name: Imposter
Imposter.Description: When destroyed: [conjure] a [1b]-cost Imp. It gains a Mustache.
Imposter.LongDescription: When destroyed: [conjure] a [1b]-cost Imp. It gains a Mustache.
Imposter.FlavorText: It's IMPossible to tell who he really is.

Trapper_Zombie.Name: Trapper Zombie
Trapper_Zombie.FlavorText: Purveyor of only the finest banana peel coats.

Fire_Rooster.Name: Fire Rooster
Fire_Rooster.Description: This moves to a random lane when a Plant is played here. When this enters a lane: Do 1 damage to all Plants there.
Fire_Rooster.LongDescription: This moves to a random lane when a Plant is played here.\nWhen this enters a lane: Do 1 damage to all Plants there.
Fire_Rooster.FlavorText: According to the Chinese Zodiac, it's the year of the Fire Rooster. Crispy fried Plants for all your Zombies!

Plucky_Clover.Name: Plucky Clover
Plucky_Clover.Description: [conjure] an Event card. Plucky Clover gets +[a] equal to that card's cost.
Plucky_Clover.LongDescription: When played: [conjure] an Event card. Plucky Clover gets +[a] equal to that card's cost.
Plucky_Clover.FlavorText: She's a giver, no doubt. But she feels like she gets a lot out of it too.

Hot_Date.Name: Hot Date
Hot_Date.Description: Move a Zombie to this lane. When destroyed: Do 3 damage to a Zombie here.
Hot_Date.LongDescription: When played: Move a Zombie to this lane.\nWhen destroyed: Do 3 damage to a Zombie here.
Hot_Date.FlavorText: He's a hot commodity on dating sites such as eGardening, Thatch.com, and OKTulip.

Bonus_Track_Buckethead.Name: Bonus Track Buckethead
Bonus_Track_Buckethead.FlavorText: He put all his favorite songs on that mixtape. If only he could find the right Zombie to give it to.

Shamrocket.Name: Shamrocket
Shamrocket.Description: Destroy a Zombie that has [4a] or more.
Shamrocket.LongDescription: Destroy a Zombie that has [4a] or more.
Shamrocket.FlavorText: The bigger they are, the harder they go boom.

Sportacus.Name: Sportacus
Sportacus.Description: When a Zombie Trick is played, do 2 damage to the Zombie Hero.
Sportacus.LongDescription: When a Zombie Trick is played, do 2 damage to the Zombie Hero.

Hippity_Hop_Gargantuar.Name: Hippity Hop Gargantuar
Hippity_Hop_Gargantuar.Description: When played and When hurt: Make a [linkmysteryegg] in a random lane.
Hippity_Hop_Gargantuar.LongDescription: When played and When hurt: Make a [linkmysteryegg] in a random lane.
Hippity_Hop_Gargantuar.FlavorText: Sometimes, what has been seen... can't be unseen. This is one of those times.

Mystery_Egg.Name: Mystery Egg
Mystery_Egg.Description: Start of Tricks: This transforms into a random Zombie that costs [2b] or less.
Mystery_Egg.LongDescription: Start of Tricks: Transform this into a random Zombie that costs [2b] or less.
Mystery_Egg.FlavorText: Mommy, where do little Zombies come from?" Asked and answered.

Sunnier-Shroom.Name: Sunnier-Shroom
Sunnier-Shroom.Description: [teamup]. Start of turn: You get [+2s] this turn.
Sunnier-Shroom.LongDescription: [teamup]\nStart of turn: You get [+2s] this turn.
Sunnier-Shroom.FlavorText: Compared to his little brother, he's the one with the sunnier disposition.

Vengeful_Cyborg.Name: Vengeful Cyborg
Vengeful_Cyborg.FlavorText: His toupee went missing in the heat of battle and he's been furious about it ever since.

Pair_Pearadise.Name: Pair Pearadise
Pair_Pearadise.Description: When you play a Plant here, make a copy of that Plant with [teamup] here.
Pair_Pearadise.LongDescription: When you play a Plant here, make a copy of that Plant with [teamup] here.
Pair_Pearadise.FlavorText: Peter Piper's Planet precociously picked a pair of pickled peppered pairs.

King_of_the_Grill.Name: King of the Grill
King_of_the_Grill.Description: [frenzy]. When a Gargantuar destroys a Plant, [conjure] a Gargantuar card.
King_of_the_Grill.LongDescription: [frenzy]\nWhen a Gargantuar destroys a Plant, [conjure] a Gargantuar card.
King_of_the_Grill.FlavorText: Chillin' beside the ol' backyard grill, cookin' up some brains, hangin' with his zombies... that's the good unlife.

Trapper_Territory.Name: Trapper Territory
Trapper_Territory.Description: Before combat here: Do 1 damage to each Plant here.
Trapper_Territory.LongDescription: Before combat here: Do 1 damage to each Plant here.
Trapper_Territory.FlavorText: Plants do not like feeling trapped. Can you blame them?

Hover-Goat_3000.Name: Hover-Goat 3000
Hover-Goat_3000.Description: [aquatic]. When played: Another Zombie gets [+2a]/[+2h]. When hurt: [bounce] this Goat.
Hover-Goat_3000.LongDescription: [aquatic]\nWhen played: Another Zombie gets [+2a]/[+2h].\nWhen hurt: [bounce] this Goat.
Hover-Goat_3000.FlavorText: The future is Hovering. The future is Radical. The future is Goat.

Bad_Moon_Rising.Name: Bad Moon Rising
Bad_Moon_Rising.Description: Transform all Zombies into random Zombies that cost [5b] or more.
Bad_Moon_Rising.LongDescription: Transform all Zombies into random Zombies that cost [5b] or more.
Bad_Moon_Rising.FlavorText: Sometimes a full moon turns bad dreams into horrible nightmares.

Imp-Throwing_Imp.Name: Imp-Throwing Imp
Imp-Throwing_Imp.Description: When hurt: Make a random Imp that costs [2b] or less in a random lane.
Imp-Throwing_Imp.LongDescription: When hurt: Make a random Imp that costs [2b] or less in a random lane.
Imp-Throwing_Imp.FlavorText: But where is the Imp-Throwing-Imp-Throwing-Imp?? We have to go deeper...

Forget-Me-Nuts.Name: Forget-Me-Nuts
Forget-Me-Nuts.FlavorText: I'd forget my own flower if it wasn't stuck to my head. Wait, what were we talking about?

Atomic_Bombegranate.Name: Atomic Bombegranate
Atomic_Bombegranate.Description: When destroyed: Make [linkseedlings] here and next door.
Atomic_Bombegranate.LongDescription: When destroyed: Make [linkseedlings] here and next door.
Atomic_Bombegranate.FlavorText: Remember: Never ever EVER split a fruit. Oh, hold on, actually fruits are ok, just never split an atom.

Go-Nuts.Name: Go-Nuts
Go-Nuts.Description: [teamup]. When you play a [teamup] Plant, all [teamup] Plants get [+1a].
Go-Nuts.LongDescription: [teamup]\nWhen you play a [teamup] Plant, all [teamup] Plants get [+1a].
Go-Nuts.FlavorText: GROW-Nuts! THROW-Nuts! When we get big we GO-Nuts! Goooooooo PLANTS!

Primal_Potato_Mine.Name: Primal Potato Mine
Primal_Potato_Mine.Description: When destroyed: Do 3 damage to a Zombie here.
Primal_Potato_Mine.LongDescription: When destroyed: Do 3 damage to a Zombie here.
Primal_Potato_Mine.FlavorText: Hidden long ago in Hollow Earth, Dinosaurs ran rampant in The Land Before Mine.

Blockbuster.Name: Blockbuster
Blockbuster.Description: [truestrike]. [plantevolution]: Destroy all Gravestones here and next door.
Blockbuster.LongDescription: [truestrike]\n[plantevolution]: Destroy all Gravestones here and next door.
Blockbuster.FlavorText: They call it a graveyard. She calls it a buffet.

Grape_Responsibility.Name: Grape Responsibility
Grape_Responsibility.FlavorText: When you think of responsibility, think of grapes.

Three-Nut.Name: Three-Nut
Three-Nut.Description: When you play a Plant, that Plant's [a] becomes [3a].
Three-Nut.LongDescription: When you play a Plant, that Plant's [a] becomes [3a].
Three-Nut.FlavorText: They say two heads are better than one. Three-Nut just took the next evolutionary step.

Tricarrotops.Name: Tricarrotops
Tricarrotops.FlavorText: Beta-Carrotina tracked Huge-Gigantacus down the tunnel Meteor Z opened to Hollow Earth. Carrots there had evolved in a very different direction.

Imitater.Name: Imitater
Imitater.Description: When you play a Plant, this transforms into a copy of that Plant.
Imitater.LongDescription: When you play a Plant, this transforms into a copy of that Plant.
Imitater.FlavorText: When asked the secret to fighting zombies, Imitater replied "...." Truly a master of his craft.

Gloom-Shroom.Name: Gloom-Shroom
Gloom-Shroom.Description: [truestrike]. [mushroomevolution]: Do 3 damage to Zombies here and next door.
Gloom-Shroom.LongDescription: [truestrike]\n[mushroomevolution]: Do 3 damage to Zombies here and next door.
Gloom-Shroom.FlavorText: Some see him as depressed, but he's got a lot of sides.

Umbrella_Leaf.Name: Umbrella Leaf
Umbrella_Leaf.Description: [teamup]. Other Plants here and next door are [untrickable].
Umbrella_Leaf.LongDescription: [teamup]\nOther Plants here and next door are [untrickable].
Umbrella_Leaf.FlavorText: She's not very frond of getting wet.

Bamboozle.Name: Bamboozle
Bamboozle.FlavorText: Only among the hyper-evolved Plants of Hollow Earth can you be outwitted by a tree.

Split_Pea.Name: Split Pea
Split_Pea.Description: Before combat here: This does 1 damage to the Plant Hero.
Split_Pea.LongDescription: Before combat here: This does 1 damage to the Plant Hero.
Split_Pea.FlavorText: All I wanted in life was to get ahead. But it kinda grew on me. How to face the future? I'm of two minds.

Gatling_Pea.Name: Gatling Pea
Gatling_Pea.FlavorText: There is no problem that cannot be solved by more peas.

Tricorn.Name: Tricorn
Tricorn.Description: Attacks here and next door. [plantevolution]: This gets [+2a].
Tricorn.LongDescription: Attacks here and next door.\n[plantevolution]: This gets [+2a].
Tricorn.FlavorText: Labor to keep alive in your breast that little spark of celestial fire called conscience." -Gourd Squashington

Jelly_Bean.Name: Jelly Bean
Jelly_Bean.Description: Gets [+1a]/[+1h] when anything is bounced. [beanevolution]: [bounce] a Zombie.
Jelly_Bean.LongDescription: This gets [+1a]/[+1h] when anything is bounced.\n[beanevolution]: [bounce] a Zombie.
Jelly_Bean.FlavorText: It's not how hard the Zombies knock you down. It's how hard you bounce back.

Lima-Pleurodon.Name: Lima-Pleurodon
Lima-Pleurodon.FlavorText: Sometimes one Plant provides both the Army and the Navy.

Kernel-Pult.Name: Kernel-Pult
Kernel-Pult.Description: [teamup]. When played on the Heights: A Zombie gets [-1a]/[-1h].
Kernel-Pult.LongDescription: [teamup]\nWhen played on the Heights: A Zombie gets [-1a]/[-1h].

Elderberry.Name: Elderberry
Elderberry.FlavorText: He makes yelling "Get off my lawn" into an art form.

Primal_Sunflower.Name: Primal Sunflower
Primal_Sunflower.FlavorText: Sunflowers are notorious pacifists. But isolated in the center of Hollow Earth, they evolved a new savagery. Sunny, adorable savagery.

Sunflower_Seed.Name: Sunflower Seed
Sunflower_Seed.FlavorText: From every night's end comes the beginning of a new Sunflower's dawn.

Ancient_Vimpire.Name: Ancient Vimpire
Ancient_Vimpire.Description: [aquatic], [frenzy]. When any Zombie with [frenzy] destroys a Plant, that Zombie gets [+2a]/[+2h].
Ancient_Vimpire.LongDescription: [aquatic],[frenzy]\nWhen any Zombie with [frenzy] destroys a Plant, that Zombie gets [+2a]/[+2h].
Ancient_Vimpire.FlavorText: Vimpirism - an ancient curse evolved from the dawn of time.

Extinction_Event.Name: Extinction Event
Extinction_Event.Description: A Plant gets [-2a]/[-2h]. All other copies of that Plant also get [-2a]/[-2h].
Extinction_Event.LongDescription: A Plant gets [-2a]/[-2h]. All other copies of that Plant also get [-2a]/[-2h].
Extinction_Event.FlavorText: Sometimes the evolutionary tree withers at the root.

Mondo_Bronto.Name: Mondo Bronto
Mondo_Bronto.Description: [aquatic]. [dinoroar]: Gets [+1a]/[+1h] and destroy all Plants here.
Mondo_Bronto.LongDescription: [aquatic]\n[dinoroar]: This gets [+1a]/[+1h] and destroy all Plants here.
Mondo_Bronto.FlavorText: Deep in Hollow Earth, Zombie warrior women tame herds of enormous dinosaurs. Any good history book will tell you that.

Zom-Blob.Name: Zom-Blob
Zom-Blob.Description: [zombieevolution]: This gets [+1a] for each Brain you got this turn.
Zom-Blob.LongDescription: [zombieevolution]: This gets [+1a] for each Brain you got this turn.
Zom-Blob.FlavorText: This is why you shouldn't drink primordial soup.

Parasol_Zombie.Name: Parasol Zombie
Parasol_Zombie.FlavorText: Her favorite author is Brain Austen.

Gargantuar_Mime.Name: Gargantuar Mime
Gargantuar_Mime.Description: When a non-Mime Plant or Zombie does a Bonus Attack, this does a Bonus Attack.
Gargantuar_Mime.LongDescription: When a non-Mime Plant or Zombie does a Bonus Attack, this does a Bonus Attack.
Gargantuar_Mime.FlavorText: The Gargantuar Mime groans like any other zombie. He just does it silently and in French.

Evolutionary_Leap.Name: Evolutionary Leap
Evolutionary_Leap.Description: Transform a Zombie into a random Zombie that costs [1b] more. Draw a card.
Evolutionary_Leap.LongDescription: Transform a Zombie into a random Zombie that costs [1b] more.\nDraw a card.
Evolutionary_Leap.FlavorText: When Dr. Zomboss sent Meteor Z and Huge-Gigantacus from space, they smashed a tunnel to the center of the Earth. There, Plants and Zombies had evolved into insane new forms.

Quickdraw_Con_Man.Name: Quickdraw Con Man
Quickdraw_Con_Man.Description: [truestrike]. When the Plant Hero draws a card, do 1 damage to them.
Quickdraw_Con_Man.LongDescription: [truestrike]\nWhen the Plant Hero draws a card, do 1 damage to them.
Quickdraw_Con_Man.FlavorText: How did he know the Plants were coming? Because four-armed is forewarned.

Zombie_Middle_Manager.Name: Zombie Middle Manager
Zombie_Middle_Manager.Description: Gets [+1a] when another Professional gets hurt. When played: [conjure] a Professional.
Zombie_Middle_Manager.LongDescription: This gets [+1a] when another Professional gets hurt.\nWhen played: [conjure] a Professional.
Zombie_Middle_Manager.FlavorText: Like most managers, bringing pain to his employees gives him strength.

Primeval_Yeti.Name: Primeval Yeti
Primeval_Yeti.FlavorText: What's for lunch? Mostly solid stone.

Jurassic_Fossilhead.Name: Jurassic Fossilhead
Jurassic_Fossilhead.FlavorText: For him, Fossilheading isn't just a hobby. It's a career.

Stompadon.Name: Stompadon
Stompadon.Description: [dinoroar]: All Zombies in your hand get [+1a]/[+1h].
Stompadon.LongDescription: [dinoroar]: All Zombies in your hand get [+1a]/[+1h].
Stompadon.FlavorText: With a cerebellum the size of a Wall-Nut, it specializes in oversized bodies for little brains.

Barrel_of_Barrels.Name: Barrel of Barrels
Barrel_of_Barrels.FlavorText: If you put a container in another container, you'll have twice the storage space!

Blowgun_Imp.Name: Blowgun Imp
Blowgun_Imp.FlavorText: Much more successful than his cousin, the Inhalegun Imp.

Cursed_Gargolith.Name: Cursed Gargolith
Cursed_Gargolith.Description: [gravestone]. When revealed: Steal 2 sections from the Plant Hero's Super-Block Meter. End of turn: All Gargantuars hide in Gravestones.
Cursed_Gargolith.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nWhen revealed: Steal 2 sections from the Plant Hero's Super-Block Meter.\nEnd of turn: All Gargantuars hide in Gravestones.
Cursed_Gargolith.FlavorText: The lost temples of Hollow Earth were mysterious and inviting. Until they started to move.

Zombot_Aerostatic_Gondola.Name: Zombot Aerostatic Gondola
Zombot_Aerostatic_Gondola.Description: [aquatic]. When this hurts the Plant Hero, it moves to a random lane and leaves behind a random Zombie.
Zombot_Aerostatic_Gondola.LongDescription: [aquatic]\nWhen this hurts the Plant Hero, it moves to a random lane and leaves behind a random Zombie.
Zombot_Aerostatic_Gondola.FlavorText: These pirates hit hard, then escape at 3 miles per hour.

Cro-Magnolia.Name: Cro-Magnolia
Cro-Magnolia.Description: [plantevolution]: Plants here and next door get [+2a].
Cro-Magnolia.LongDescription: [plantevolution]: Plants here and next door get [+2a].
Cro-Magnolia.FlavorText: In the secret groves of Hollow Earth, Magnolias evolved to shun steely stoicism, boasting blunt barbarity.

Grave_Mistake.Name: Grave Mistake
Grave_Mistake.FlavorText: Warning: Don't flick gravestones in real life.

Fireweed.Name: Fireweed
Fireweed.Description: When played on the Ground: Make [linklava] here.
Fireweed.LongDescription: When played on the Ground: Make [linklava] here.
Fireweed.FlavorText: Don't touch the floor. The floor is lava.

Tankylosaurus.Name: Tankylosaurus
Tankylosaurus.Description: [dinoroar]: Do 2 damage to a random Plant or Plant Hero.
Tankylosaurus.LongDescription: [dinoroar]: Do 2 damage to a random Plant or Plant Hero.
Tankylosaurus.FlavorText: When not exploring Hollow Earth's jungles, they like to go clubbing.

Cob_Cannon.Name: Cob Cannon
Cob_Cannon.Description: Zombies here and next door get [-1a]/[-1h]. [teamupevolution]: Destroy a Zombie.
Cob_Cannon.LongDescription: When played: Zombies here and next door get [-1a]/[-1h].\n[teamupevolution]: Destroy a Zombie.
Cob_Cannon.FlavorText: He focuses his fearsome firepower with a single, ringing credo: "One Team. One Dream.

Transfiguration.Name: Transfiguration
Transfiguration.Description: End of turn: This transforms into a random Plant that costs 1 more. It keeps this ability.
Transfiguration.LongDescription: End of turn: This transforms into a random Plant that costs 1 more. \nIt keeps this ability.
Transfiguration.FlavorText: By Heisenberg's Uncertainty Principle, if you look at a Plant too closely, you actually change what that Plant is...

Witch_Hazel.Name: Witch Hazel
Witch_Hazel.Description: End of turn: Destroy a random Zombie and make a [1a]/[1h] Puff-Shroom with [teamup] there.
Witch_Hazel.LongDescription: End of turn: Destroy a random Zombie and make a [1a]/[1h] Puff-Shroom with [teamup] there.
Witch_Hazel.FlavorText: Zombies are always trying to build a bridge out of her.

Ketchup_Mechanic.Name: Ketchup Mechanic
Ketchup_Mechanic.Description: When played: For each Zombie, this gets [+1a]/[+1h] and Heal the Plant Hero for 1.
Ketchup_Mechanic.LongDescription: When played: For each Zombie, this gets [+1a]/[+1h] and Heal the Plant Hero for 1.
Ketchup_Mechanic.FlavorText: Catchup mechanics help you get back in a game when you're behind. Ketchup Mechanics fix your fruit.

Fraidy_Cat.Name: Fraidy Cat
Fraidy_Cat.Description: When a Plant Trick is played, this gets [+1a]/[+1h] and moves to a random lane.
Fraidy_Cat.LongDescription: When a Plant Trick is played, this gets [+1a]/[+1h] and moves to a random lane.
Fraidy_Cat.FlavorText: What's a black cat's favorite color? Purrrrr-ple.

Exploding_Fruitcake.Name: Exploding Fruitcake
Exploding_Fruitcake.Description: Do 5 damage to a Plant. The Plant player [conjures] a Fruit.
Exploding_Fruitcake.LongDescription: Do 5 damage to a Plant. The Plant player [conjures] a Fruit.
Exploding_Fruitcake.FlavorText: Once you get past all the dynamite and bombs, fruitcakes actually contain at least 5% Fruit.

Sneezing_Zombie.Name: Sneezing Zombie
Sneezing_Zombie.Description: Plants and the Plant Hero can't be healed. All Plants get [-1a]/[-1h].
Sneezing_Zombie.LongDescription: Plants and the Plant Hero can't be healed.\nWhen played: All Plants get [-1a]/[-1h].
Sneezing_Zombie.FlavorText: Flowers give her awful allergies and sickening sneezes. Is that why she wears one on her head?

Unexpected_Gifts.Name: Unexpected Gifts
Unexpected_Gifts.Description: [conjure] three Event cards. Then the Plant player [conjures] an Event card.
Unexpected_Gifts.LongDescription: [conjure] three Event cards. Then the Plant player [conjures] an Event card.
Unexpected_Gifts.FlavorText: For the 4th day of Feastivus, my true love gave to me: 1 Fire Rooster, 1 Sneezing Zombie, 1 Bad Moon Rising, and a partridge in a Pear Tree!

Pumpkin_Shell.Name: Pumpkin Shell
Pumpkin_Shell.Description: [springboard]: A Plant played on this gets [+2a]/[+4h].
Pumpkin_Shell.LongDescription: [springboard]: A Plant played on this gets [+2a]/[+4h].
Pumpkin_Shell.FlavorText: Build your house on a solid foundation," they said. "Build your house on pumpkin.

Primal_Wall-Nut.Name: Primal Wall-Nut
Primal_Wall-Nut.Description: [teamup], [untrickable]. [conjure] a card that costs [4s] or more.
Primal_Wall-Nut.LongDescription: [teamup], [untrickable]\nWhen played: [conjure] a card that costs [4s] or more.
Primal_Wall-Nut.FlavorText: You can't be destroyed by a Rolling Stone when you basically are a Rolling Stone.

Marine_Bean.Name: Marine Bean
Marine_Bean.Description: [aquatic]. When played: Gets [+1a]/[+1h] for each other [aquatic] Plant.
Marine_Bean.LongDescription: [aquatic]\nWhen played: This gets [+1a]/[+1h] for each other [aquatic] Plant.
Marine_Bean.FlavorText: Of course beans evolved gills. How else would they breathe underwater?

Loco_Coco.Name: Loco Coco
Loco_Coco.Description: Make [wallnuts] next door. [nutevolution]: Plants with no [a] get [+3a].
Loco_Coco.LongDescription: When played: Make [wallnuts] next door.\n[nutevolution]: Plants with no [a] get [+3a].
Loco_Coco.FlavorText: He crowned himself King of All Hollow Earth. No one had the heart to tell him it was actually a parliamentary democracy.

Shelf_Mushroom.Name: Shelf Mushroom
Shelf_Mushroom.FlavorText: Legends of Hollow Earth whisper that if you stack up enough Shelf Mushrooms, you'll eventually reach the Surface World.

Strawberrian.Name: Strawberrian
Strawberrian.Description: When you play a Berry, do 1 damage to Zombies next door to Strawberrian. [berryevolution]: Gain a Berry Blast.
Strawberrian.LongDescription: When you play a Berry, do 1 damage to Zombies next door to Strawberrian.\n[berryevolution]: Gain a Berry Blast.
Strawberrian.FlavorText: When it's time to fight, he gets pretty juiced.

Veloci-Radish_Packmate.Name: Veloci-Radish Packmate
Veloci-Radish_Packmate.Description: Make a copy of this with [teamup] here. [dinoroar]: Gets [+1a].
Veloci-Radish_Packmate.LongDescription: When played: Make a copy of this with [teamup] here.\n[dinoroar]: This gets [+1a].
Veloci-Radish_Packmate.FlavorText: Dedicated pack hunters, one roars a distraction while the other strikes from the side.

Typical_Beanstalk.Name: Typical Beanstalk
Typical_Beanstalk.Description: When played next to a Leafy Plant: This gets [+1h] and [conjure] a Leafy card.
Typical_Beanstalk.LongDescription: When played next to a Leafy Plant: This gets [+1h] and [conjure] a Leafy card.
Typical_Beanstalk.FlavorText: Everyone's magic in their own special way. Everyone except me.

Pea_Patch.Name: Pea Patch
Pea_Patch.Description: [springboard]: A Plant played on this gets [+2a]/[+2h].
Pea_Patch.LongDescription: [springboard]: A Plant played on this gets [+2a]/[+2h].
Pea_Patch.FlavorText: Don't let the Dog Walker anywhere near it.

Savage_Spinach.Name: Savage Spinach
Savage_Spinach.Description: [leafyevolution]: All Plants in all lanes and your hand get [+2a].
Savage_Spinach.LongDescription: [leafyevolution]: All Plants in all lanes and your hand get [+2a].
Savage_Spinach.FlavorText: Neptuna planned her Triassic Invasion perfectly. But like so many conquerors before her, she underestimated the Spinach.

Apotatosaurus.Name: Apotatosaurus
Apotatosaurus.FlavorText: Some potatoes are sweet. Others are dinosaurs.

Primal_Peashooter.Name: Primal Peashooter
Primal_Peashooter.Description: When this hurts a Zombie, [bounce] that Zombie.
Primal_Peashooter.LongDescription: When this hurts a Zombie, [bounce] that Zombie.

Lily_Pad.Name: Lily Pad
Lily_Pad.Description: [aquatic]. [springboard]: A Plant played on this gets [aquatic]. [conjure] a Leafy card.
Lily_Pad.LongDescription: [aquatic]\n[springboard]: A Plant played on this gets [aquatic]. [conjure] a Leafy card.
Lily_Pad.FlavorText: When Neptuna's Triassic Invasion flooded Hollow Earth with vast new oceans, Plants quickly evolved to survive.

Rotobaga.Name: Rotobaga
Rotobaga.Description: [aquatic]. Attacks both lanes next door instead of this lane.
Rotobaga.LongDescription: [aquatic]\nThis attacks both lanes next door instead of this lane.
Rotobaga.FlavorText: Without flying roots, how would we get Sky-Trees??

Shrinking_Violet.Name: Shrinking Violet
Shrinking_Violet.Description: A Zombie and Zombies next door to it get [-2a]. Then destroy any of those Zombies that have [0a].
Shrinking_Violet.LongDescription: A Zombie and Zombies next door to it get [-2a]. Then destroy any of those Zombies that have [0a].
Shrinking_Violet.FlavorText: Is she cute or terrifying? Yes.

Bird_of_Paradise.Name: Bird of Paradise
Bird_of_Paradise.FlavorText: Her beautiful melodies are echoed by the roars of dinosaurs.

Cross-Pollination.Name: Cross-Pollination
Cross-Pollination.Description: [Conjure] a Flower. [Conjure] a Fruit. They both cost 1 less.
Cross-Pollination.LongDescription: [Conjure] a Flower. [Conjure] a Fruit. \nThey both cost 1 less.
Cross-Pollination.FlavorText: Each Plant is grown with the power of solar radiation. Sometimes you just have to let it out.

Aloesaurus.Name: Aloesaurus
Aloesaurus.Description: [dinoroar]: Heal all Plants and the Plant Hero for 1.
Aloesaurus.LongDescription: [dinoroar]: Heal all Plants and the Plant Hero for 1.
Aloesaurus.FlavorText: A roaring force of life. A crushing force of destruction.

Killer_Whale.Name: Killer Whale
Killer_Whale.Description: [aquatic]. [springboard]: A Zombie played on this gets [+2a]/[+1h] and [aquatic].
Killer_Whale.LongDescription: [aquatic]\n[springboard]: A Zombie played on this gets [+2a]/[+1h] and [aquatic].
Killer_Whale.FlavorText: Flooding Hollow Earth with water from above, Neptuna attacked with flying whale cavalry. Or really, falling whale cavalry.

Hunting_Grounds.Name: Hunting Grounds
Hunting_Grounds.Description: Zombies here have [hunt]. When a Zombie enters or leaves this lane, it gets [+1a]/[+1h].
Hunting_Grounds.LongDescription: Zombies here have [hunt]. When a Zombie enters or leaves this lane, it gets [+1a]/[+1h].
Hunting_Grounds.FlavorText: Are the Zombies hunting dinosaurs, or are the dinosaurs hunting them?

Gargantuar-Throwing_Gargantuar.Name: Garg_Throwing_Garg
Gargantuar-Throwing_Gargantuar.Description: When hurt: Make another random Gargantuar in a random lane.
Gargantuar-Throwing_Gargantuar.LongDescription: When hurt: Make another random Gargantuar in a random lane.
Gargantuar-Throwing_Gargantuar.FlavorText: The ultimate, epic, last, absolutely final conclusion to the Zombie-throwing Zombie saga.  ...or is it?

Mustache_Waxer.Name: Mustache Waxer
Mustache_Waxer.Description: When you play a Mustache, this gets [+2h] and you get [+1b].
Mustache_Waxer.LongDescription: When you play a Mustache, this gets [+2h] and you get [+1b].
Mustache_Waxer.FlavorText: Customers have been telling him "Get a brain" for years now.

Quarterly_Bonus.Name: Quarterly Bonus
Quarterly_Bonus.Description: Strength of a Zombie becomes 4, then it does a Bonus Attack.
Quarterly_Bonus.LongDescription: Strength of a Zombie becomes 4, then it does a Bonus Attack.
Quarterly_Bonus.FlavorText: Zombie Pirates kick a lot of booty. Maybe someday they'll figure out to spend it.

Mustache_Monument.Name: Mustache Monument
Mustache_Monument.Description: [springboard]: A Zombie played on this does a Bonus Attack.
Mustache_Monument.LongDescription: [springboard]: A Zombie played on this does a Bonus Attack.
Mustache_Monument.FlavorText: If Neptuna's Triassic Invasion force can align all of Hollow Earth's Mustache Monuments at once, she will become truly unstoppable.

Duckstache.Name: Duckstache
Duckstache.Description: When this does damage: [conjure] a Mustache. [mustacheevolution]: This gets [+3a]/[+3h].
Duckstache.LongDescription: When this does damage: [conjure] a Mustache.\n[mustacheevolution]: This gets [+3a]/[+3h].
Duckstache.FlavorText: Determined to find every Mustache Monument in Hollow Earth, Neptuna brought in the experts.

Zombot_Dinotronic_Mechasaur.Name: Zombot Dinotronic Mechasaur
Zombot_Dinotronic_Mechasaur.Description: [truestrike]. [dinoroar]: Make a random History Zombie in a random lane.
Zombot_Dinotronic_Mechasaur.LongDescription: [truestrike]\n[dinoroar]: Make a random History Zombie in a random lane.
Zombot_Dinotronic_Mechasaur.FlavorText: What's better than a dinosaur? A gigantic, metal, laser monster that gates in four more dinosaurs.

Disco_Dance_Floor.Name: Disco Dance Floor
Disco_Dance_Floor.Description: [overshoot=2]. [springboard]: a Zombie played on this gets [overshoot=2].
Disco_Dance_Floor.LongDescription: [overshoot=2]\n[springboard]: a Zombie played on this gets [overshoot=2].
Disco_Dance_Floor.FlavorText: The Triassic Invasion brought the very best of Zombie culture: Disco.

Zombie's_Best_Friend.Name: Zombie's Best Friend
Zombie's_Best_Friend.Description: When played next to a Zombie: Make another random Zombie that costs [1b].
Zombie's_Best_Friend.LongDescription: When played next to a Zombie: Make another random Zombie that costs [1b].
Zombie's_Best_Friend.FlavorText: What counts is not necessarily the size of the dog in the fight; it's the size of the fight in the dog." - Wight Z. Diesenhower

Knockout.Name: Knockout
Knockout.Description: Choose a lane. Destroy all Plants there with [3a] or less.
Knockout.LongDescription: Choose a lane. Destroy all Plants there with [3a] or less.
Knockout.FlavorText: No one knows where the giant green hand and the giant purple hand comes from. What will happen when they clap?

Bobblehead.Name: Bobblehead
Bobblehead.Description: When you play a Dancing card, do 2 damage to the Plant Hero. [dancingevolution]: This gets [+2a]/[+2h] and [truestrike].
Bobblehead.LongDescription: When you play a Dancing card, do 2 damage to the Plant Hero.\n[dancingevolution]: This gets [+2a]/[+2h] and [truestrike].
Bobblehead.FlavorText: He offers a special deal: Two of his heads for one of yours. Anyway you slice it, you still come out a head.

Turquoise_Skull_Zombie.Name: Turquoise Skull Zombie
Turquoise_Skull_Zombie.Description: [gravestone]. Start of turn: The Plant player loses [1s]. This gets [+1a]/[+1h].
Turquoise_Skull_Zombie.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nStart of turn: The Plant player loses [1s]. This gets [+1a]/[+1h].
Turquoise_Skull_Zombie.FlavorText: The mystical Turquoise Skull stole the sun itself, lighting the way to the Mustache Monuments.

Lost_Colosseum.Name: Lost Colosseum
Lost_Colosseum.Description: [frenzy]. [springboard]: A Zombie played on this gets [+2a]/[+3h] and [frenzy].
Lost_Colosseum.LongDescription: [frenzy]\n[springboard]: A Zombie played on this gets [+2a]/[+3h] and [frenzy].
Lost_Colosseum.FlavorText: The Legend of the Mustache Monuments led Zombie explorers to uncover ancient colosseums.

Grave_Robber.Name: Grave Robber
Grave_Robber.Description: [truestrike]. Gets [+1a] when a Zombie is revealed from a Gravestone.
Grave_Robber.LongDescription: [truestrike]\nThis gets [+1a] when a Zombie is revealed from a Gravestone.
Grave_Robber.FlavorText: Why not rob graves? They're not going to miss it. It's not like the dead are rising up or anything.

Chum_Champion.Name: Chum Champion
Chum_Champion.Description: All Plants get [-1a]. [sportsevolution]: Destroy all Plants with [2a] or less.
Chum_Champion.LongDescription: When played: All Plants get [-1a].\n[sportsevolution]: Destroy all Plants with [2a] or less.
Chum_Champion.FlavorText: The Retiarius gladiator was classically armed with a trident, a net, and a 10-day-old fish.

Excavator_Zombie.Name: Excavator Zombie
Excavator_Zombie.Description: [gravestone]. When revealed: [bounce] an Environment and all Plants there.
Excavator_Zombie.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nWhen revealed: [bounce] an Environment and all Plants there.
Excavator_Zombie.FlavorText: He loved finding dinosaur fossils, until the dinosaurs started finding him.

Buried_Treasure.Name: Buried Treasure
Buried_Treasure.Description: [springboard]: [conjure] a Legendary card, and it costs [1b] less.
Buried_Treasure.LongDescription: [springboard]: [conjure] a Legendary card, and it costs [1b] less.
Buried_Treasure.FlavorText: Neptuna knew only one way to motivate an army of invading zombie pirates. Tell them about the secret treasure.

Monkey_Smuggler.Name: Monkey Smuggler
Monkey_Smuggler.Description: [gravestone]. When revealed: Steal a section from the Plant Hero's Super-Block Meter.
Monkey_Smuggler.LongDescription: [gravestone]\nWhen revealed: Steal a section from the Plant Hero's Super-Block Meter.

Unthawed_Viking.Name: Unthawed Viking
Unthawed_Viking.Description: [aquatic]. When Played [freeze] all Plants here. [pirateevolution]: This gets [+1a]/[+1h] and [freeze] all Plants in all lanes.
Unthawed_Viking.LongDescription: [aquatic]\nWhen played: [freeze] all Plants here.\n[pirateevolution]: Instead, this gets [+1a]/[+1h] and [freeze] all Plants in all lanes.
Unthawed_Viking.FlavorText: What's the best way to cross the ocean? Freeze it first. How hard could it be?

Raiding_Raptor.Name: Raiding Raptor
Raiding_Raptor.Description: [dinoroar]: This gets [+2a]. When this hurts the Plant Hero, [conjure] a card that costs [2b] or less.
Raiding_Raptor.LongDescription: [dinoroar]: This gets [+2a].\nWhen this hurts the Plant Hero, [conjure] a card that costs [2b] or less.
Raiding_Raptor.FlavorText: Amazomb helmets mostly protect their ears from all the roaring.

Frankentuar.Name: Frankentuar
Frankentuar.Description: [splashdamage=2] Gets [+1a]/[+1h] when a Zombie is destroyed.
Frankentuar.LongDescription: [splashdamage=2] This gets [+1a]/[+1h] when a Zombie is destroyed.
Frankentuar.FlavorText: IT'S ALIVE! IT'S ALI-I-I-IVE! Ok, strictly speaking, it's not alive.
